subject: Cellular Senescence

context.en-US: Senescent cells are linked to many age-related conditions, including osteoarthritis, poor wound healing, and neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's, according to senior author Pam Maher. The harmful factors senescent cells release (the SASP) promote tissue dysfunction and disease development in surrounding tissue. Because senescence and ferroptosis are both independently linked to age-related dysfunction, the discovery that elevated acid ceramidase makes senescent cells more susceptible to ferroptosis offers a two-birds-with-one-stone strategy: eliminating senescent cells while keeping neighboring cells healthy. Clearing senescent cells is considered a promising therapeutic approach for a multitude of age-related diseases and disorders.
context.zh-TW: 根據資深作者Pam Maher，衰老細胞與許多年齡相關疾病有關，包括骨關節炎、傷口癒合不良，以及阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症等神經退化性疾病。衰老細胞釋放的有害因子（SASP）會促進周圍組織的功能障礙與疾病發展。由於衰老與鐵依賴性細胞死亡均獨立地與年齡相關功能障礙有關，酸性神經醯胺酶升高使衰老細胞更易發生鐵依賴性細胞死亡的發現，提供了一石二鳥的策略：在清除衰老細胞的同時，保持鄰近細胞健康。清除衰老細胞被認為是治療多種年齡相關疾病與障礙的具前景療法。

subject: Cellular Senescence

context.en-US: Senescent cells are linked to many age-related conditions, including osteoarthritis (arthritis), poor wound healing, and neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's or Parkinson's. The pro-inflammatory factors that senescent cells secrete into surrounding tissues promote tissue dysfunction and disease development, contributing to the joint degeneration seen in arthritis. The Salk findings suggest that making senescent cells vulnerable to ferroptosis through acid ceramidase could provide a novel target for therapeutics applicable to a multitude of diseases and disorders, including arthritis. Senescent cells are considered a hallmark of aging, and clearing them is a major goal of senolytic research for extending healthspan.
context.zh-TW: 衰老細胞與許多年齡相關疾病有關，包括骨關節炎（關節炎）、傷口癒合不良，以及阿茲海默症或帕金森氏症等神經退化性疾病。衰老細胞分泌至周圍組織的促發炎因子會促進組織功能障礙與疾病發展，促成關節炎中所見的關節退化。Salk團隊的發現顯示，透過酸性神經醯胺酶使衰老細胞易受鐵依賴性細胞死亡影響，可為適用於多種疾病與障礙（包括關節炎）的療法提供新穎標靶。衰老細胞被視為衰老的特徵之一，清除它們是延長健康壽命之衰老細胞清除研究的主要目標。

subject: Cellular Senescence

context.en-US: Senescent cells can promote the development of diseases or disorders, including cancer, through the harmful factors they release into surrounding tissues (the senescence-associated secretory phenotype, or SASP). Though sometimes harmless, senescent cells that accumulate with age produce a pro-inflammatory environment that supports tumor development and age-related tissue dysfunction. This is why senescent cells are a hallmark of aging and why strategies to clear them - for example, via the acid ceramidase/ferroptosis axis - are pursued as senolytic approaches. Senescent cells are linked to many age-related conditions including arthritis, poor wound healing, and neurodegenerative diseases.
context.zh-TW: 衰老細胞可透過其釋放至周圍組織的有害因子（衰老相關分泌表型，簡稱SASP）促進疾病或障礙的發展，包括癌症。衰老細胞雖有時無害，但隨年齡累積的衰老細胞會製造促發炎環境，支持腫瘤發展與年齡相關的組織功能障礙。這就是為什麼衰老細胞被視為衰老的特徵之一，也是為什麼清除它們的策略——例如經由酸性神經醯胺酶/鐵依賴性細胞死亡軸——被作為衰老細胞清除（senolytic）途徑來研究。衰老細胞與許多年齡相關疾病有關，包括關節炎、傷口癒合不良與神經退化性疾病。

subject: Cellular Senescence

context.en-US: Senescent cells - often called 'zombie' cells - are a hallmark of aging: they do not completely die but also are not quite alive, and while sometimes harmless, they release harmful factors called the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) into surrounding tissues. This secretory phenotype is pro-inflammatory and can promote the development of diseases or disorders, including cancer, and accelerates aging by driving tissue dysfunction. Because senescent cells are linked to many age-related conditions including arthritis, poor wound healing, and neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's, clearing them - as proposed through acid ceramidase-mediated ferroptosis sensitization - is a major strategy for extending healthspan.
context.zh-TW: 衰老細胞——常被稱為「殭屍」細胞——是衰老的特徵之一：它們不會完全死亡，卻也不完全活著；雖然有時無害，它們會將稱為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）的有害因子釋放到周圍組織。這種分泌表型具促發炎性，可促進包括癌症在內的疾病或障礙發展，並透過驅動組織功能障礙而加速衰老。由於衰老細胞與許多年齡相關疾病有關，包括關節炎、傷口癒合不良，以及阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症等神經退化性疾病，清除它們——如透過酸性神經醯胺酶介導的鐵依賴性細胞死亡敏感化所提出——是延長健康壽命的主要策略。

subject: Cellular Senescence

context.en-US: Vulnerable senescent cells are able to pass their ferroptosis vulnerability on to neighboring cells, helping explain why only a few senescent cells can turn into more and ultimately impact a larger tissue over time. This paracrine transmission of ferroptosis sensitivity means that a small number of senescent cells can spread susceptibility to ferroptotic death across a tissue, and it represents one mechanism by which the Salk team found ferroptosis and senescence to be connected during aging. The researchers describe the target as eliminating senescent cells while keeping neighboring cells healthy for longer, and the finding underpins the therapeutic rationale for targeting acid ceramidase.
context.zh-TW: 脆弱的衰老細胞能將其鐵依賴性細胞死亡的脆弱性傳遞給鄰近細胞，這有助於解釋為何少數衰老細胞能轉變為更多衰老細胞，並最終隨時間影響更大的組織。這種鐵依賴性細胞死亡敏感性的旁分泌傳遞，意味著少數衰老細胞就能將對鐵依賴性細胞死亡的易感性擴散至整個組織；Salk團隊發現這是鐵依賴性細胞死亡與衰老在老化過程中相互關聯的機制之一。研究人員將目標描述為清除衰老細胞，同時讓鄰近細胞更長久地保持健康；此發現支持了以酸性神經醯胺酶為標靶的治療學理。

subject: cGAS-STING Pathway

context.en-US: mtDNA-cGAS-STING signalling and mitochondrial control of histone acetylation operate as independently regulated pathways: senescent BAX- and BAK-deficient fibroblasts show reduced SASP gene expression from impaired cytosolic mtDNA release yet unchanged H3K27ac at SASP loci, and STING inhibition suppresses SASP without affecting histone acetylation. Despite this independence the pathways functionally cooperate: disruption of either is sufficient to suppress SASP while activation of either alone is not sufficient to fully restore it. Acetyl-CoA enables chromatin accessibility at SASP loci while mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling provides the activation required to engage these regions.
context.zh-TW: mtDNA-cGAS-STING訊息傳導與粒線體對組蛋白乙醯化的調控，是作為獨立調控的途徑運作的：衰老的BAX與BAK缺陷纖維母細胞因細胞質mtDNA釋放受損而表現出SASP基因表現降低，但SASP基因座的H3K27ac維持不變；抑制STING可抑制SASP，卻不影響組蛋白乙醯化。儘管彼此獨立，這些途徑在功能上仍相互合作：破壞任何一者都足以抑制SASP，而單獨活化任何一者都不足以完全恢復SASP。乙醯輔酶A（Acetyl-CoA）賦予SASP基因座染色質可及性，而mtDNA驅動的先天免疫訊息傳導則提供參與這些區域所需的活化訊號。

subject: Chlorpromazine

context.en-US: Chlorpromazine, a phenothiazine carrying an amine side chain on its 10-nitrogen, was the only compound among those tested that failed to protect HT-22 cells in the rotenone neurotoxicity model. The 10-N substitution causes a roughly 1000-fold loss of potency relative to methylene blue in glutamate, IAA, and rotenone assays, and abolishes the complex I-to-cytochrome c electron shunt, oxygen consumption enhancement, and glycolysis suppression. In the lysate oxidation assay chlorpromazine increased DCF fluorescence with or without mitochondria and NADH, behaving as a pro-oxidant and explaining its weak neuroprotection.
context.zh-TW: 氯丙嗪（chlorpromazine）是在其10-氮上帶有胺側鏈的吩噻嗪（phenothiazine），是受測化合物中唯一無法在魚藤酮（rotenone）神經毒性模型中保護HT-22細胞的化合物。與亞甲藍（methylene blue）相比，10-N取代在麩胺酸（glutamate）、IAA與魚藤酮試驗中造成約1000倍的效力損失，並消除複合體I至細胞色素c的電子分流、耗氧量增強與糖解抑制。在裂解液氧化試驗中，氯丙嗪在有或無粒線體與NADH的情況下皆增加DCF螢光，表現出促氧化劑（pro-oxidant）行為，這解釋了其微弱的神經保護作用。

context.en-US: Sarcopenia is an age-related condition marked by declining muscle mass, strength, and functional capacity. Creatine supplementation combined with resistance training is an effective countermeasure: studies in older adults (>65 years) taking 5 g/day during heavy resistance training promoted greater gains in muscle mass and isometric strength, and meta-analyses confirm that older individuals doing resistance training gain more muscle mass, strength, and functional capacity when supplementing creatine. Creatine also preserves muscle mass and promotes fat loss during energy-restricted diets, helping manage adult-onset obesity while preventing the muscle loss that commonly accompanies weight loss in older individuals.
context.zh-TW: 肌少症（sarcopenia）是一種以肌肉質量、力量與功能能力下降為特徵的與年齡相關疾病。肌酸（creatine）補充合併阻力訓練是有效的對策：針對65歲以上老年人的研究顯示，在重度阻力訓練期間每天攝取5 g肌酸，可促進肌肉質量與等長肌力的更大增長；統合分析也證實，進行阻力訓練的老年人補充肌酸後可獲得更多肌肉質量、力量與功能能力。肌酸在能量限制飲食期間還能保留肌肉質量並促進脂肪減少，有助於管理成年型肥胖，同時防止老年人減重時常見的肌肉流失。

context.en-US: Creatine supplementation has been reported to lower plasma homocysteine, an effect that may reduce cardiovascular disease risk. Because homocysteine is methylated back to methionine by enzymes that require the same methyl-donor pool (S-adenosyl methionine) used for creatine synthesis, supplying exogenous creatine spares methyl groups that would otherwise be consumed in endogenous creatine formation, thereby lowering homocysteine production. Studies in individuals adhering to vegan diets (who tend to have elevated homocysteine) reported that creatine supplementation reduced homocysteine levels and improved systemic microvascular endothelial function, supporting creatine's role in cardiovascular health beyond its direct effects on muscle bioenergetics.
context.zh-TW: 據報導，肌酸補充可降低血漿同半胱胺酸（homocysteine），此效果可能降低心血管疾病風險。由於同半胱胺酸需由酵素甲基化轉回甲硫胺酸（methionine），而這些酵素所需的甲基供體池（S-腺苷甲硫胺酸）與肌酸合成所用者相同，補充外源性肌酸可節省否則將消耗於內源性肌酸形成的甲基，從而降低同半胱胺酸的產生。針對遵循純素飲食（其同半胱胺酸往往較高）之個體的研究報告指出，肌酸補充可降低同半胱胺酸濃度並改善全身微血管內皮功能，支持肌酸在肌肉生物能量學直接效應之外對心血管健康的貢獻。

context.en-US: Creatine down-regulates the expression of toll-like receptors, including TLR-2, TLR-3, TLR-4, and TLR-7, in a mouse macrophage cell line (RAW 254.7). This downregulation could reduce the ability to sense some infections in immunocompromised individuals, but TLR-4 downregulation may also alter Parkinson's disease pathology and inhibit neuronal death as the disease progresses. Creatine's influence on toll-like receptors is one component of its broader immunomodulatory effects, which also include altering cytokine production, possibly through the NF-kB signaling pathway, thereby affecting cytokines, receptors, and growth factors that shape immune responses and inflammation.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸會在小鼠巨噬細胞株（RAW 254.7）中下調toll-like受體的表現，包括TLR-2、TLR-3、TLR-4與TLR-7。此下調可能降低免疫功能低下個體感知某些感染的能力，但TLR-4的下調也可能改變帕金森氏症的病程，並在疾病進展過程中抑制神經元死亡。肌酸對toll-like受體的影響是其更廣泛免疫調節效應的組成部分之一；這些效應還包括改變細胞激素的產生（可能經由NF-kB訊息傳導途徑），從而影響塑造免疫反應與發炎的細胞激素、受體與生長因子。

context.en-US: Creatine supplementation increases brain phosphocreatine content by 5-15% and enhances brain bioenergetics, which is thought to underlie its cognitive benefits. Studies report that creatine attenuates mental fatigue and improves cognition, executive function, working memory, and processing speed, especially in older adults and during sleep deprivation. Examples include improved working memory and processing speed after 5 g/day for 6 weeks, better maintenance of mood, balance, and reaction time after sleep deprivation, and improved long-term memory and random number generation in elderly participants. While not all studies show benefit, the evidence supports creatine as a modest cognitive enhancer, particularly under metabolic or cognitive stress.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸補充可使腦部磷酸肌酸含量增加5–15%並增強腦部生物能量學，此被認為是其認知益處的基礎。研究報告指出，肌酸可減輕精神疲勞，並改善認知、執行功能、工作記憶與處理速度，尤其是在老年人與睡眠剝奪期間。例子包括：每天5 g持續6週後工作記憶與處理速度改善；睡眠剝奪後情緒、平衡與反應時間維持得更好；以及老年受試者的長期記憶與隨機數字生成能力改善。雖然並非所有研究都顯示益處，證據仍支持肌酸是溫和的認知增強劑，特別是在代謝或認知壓力下。

context.en-US: Creatine supplementation is one of the most studied and effective ergogenic aids for athletes. It increases muscle creatine and phosphocreatine levels, enhances acute exercise capacity, and improves training adaptations, yielding roughly 10-20% improvements in high-intensity exercise tasks across fitness activities, golf, volleyball, soccer, softball, ice hockey, running, and swimming. The International Society of Sports Nutrition concludes creatine is the most effective ergogenic supplement available for increasing high-intensity exercise capacity and lean body mass during training. Ergogenic benefits are seen in men and women across ages from children to the elderly, although most studies have been conducted in men.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸補充是研究最充分、對運動員最有效的增能（ergogenic）輔助品之一。它可增加肌肉肌酸與磷酸肌酸濃度、增強急性運動能力並改善訓練適應，在高強度運動任務中帶來約10–20%的改善，涵蓋健身活動、高爾夫、排球、足球、壘球、冰球、跑步與游泳。國際運動營養學會（International Society of Sports Nutrition）結論指出，肌酸是現有最有效的增能補充品，可提高訓練期間的高強度運動能力與淨體重。從兒童到老年人的各年齡層、無論男女都可見增能效益，不過多數研究是在男性中進行的。

context.en-US: Creatine augments the anticancer efficacy of the metabolite methylglyoxal (MG). Creatine content and energy availability are low in several types of malignant cells and in the T cells that mediate immune responses against cancer, and the creatine transporter SLC6A8 is markedly increased in tumor-infiltrating immune cells. Patra et al. reported that MG efficacy is significantly augmented in the presence of creatine, and combined administration of creatine, methylglyoxal, and ascorbic acid provided greater efficacy and eliminated visible signs of tumor growth. Creatine and creatine kinase, very low in sarcoma tissue, were significantly elevated with concomitant regression of tumor cells.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸可增強代謝物甲基乙二醛（methylglyoxal，MG）的抗癌療效。多種惡性細胞以及介導抗癌免疫反應的T細胞中，肌酸含量與能量可用性均偏低；而腫瘤浸潤免疫細胞中的肌酸轉運蛋白SLC6A8則顯著增加。Patra等人報告，在肌酸存在下MG的療效顯著增強；合併投予肌酸、甲基乙二醛與抗壞血酸（ascorbic acid）可提供更大的療效，並消除可見的腫瘤生長跡象。肉瘤組織中原本極低的肌酸與肌酸激酶顯著升高，伴隨腫瘤細胞的消退。

context.en-US: Creatine is reported to exert antioxidant effects, scavenging reactive oxygen and nitrogen species and stabilizing membranes, effects that are proposed to protect tissues from oxidative damage. Some studies suggest creatine supplementation reduces markers of oxidative stress and muscle damage after intense exercise, and experimental work indicates creatine can directly scavenge superoxide and peroxynitrite in vitro. Because oxidative stress contributes to DNA damage and tumor promotion, creatine's antioxidant capacity is cited in the trace as one possible mechanism for an anti-cancer effect, although direct evidence linking creatine's antioxidant action to cancer prevention in humans is lacking.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸據報導具有抗氧化作用，可清除活性氧與活性氮物種並穩定細胞膜，這些作用被認為能保護組織免受氧化損傷。部分研究顯示，補充肌酸可降低劇烈運動後的氧化壓力與肌肉損傷指標，而實驗研究亦指出肌酸在體外能直接清除超氧化物與過氧亞硝酸鹽。由於氧化壓力會促成 DNA 損傷與腫瘤促進，肌酸的抗氧化能力在該追蹤中被引述為抗癌作用的可能機制之一，儘管目前缺乏直接證據將肌酸的抗氧化作用與人類癌症預防連結起來。

context.en-US: Creatine supplementation is one of the most effective and best-documented ergogenic aids for improving performance in high-intensity, short-duration activities. By increasing muscle phosphocreatine stores, creatine enhances the capacity to regenerate ATP during repeated bouts of maximal exercise, increasing power output, strength gains during resistance training, and work performed in repeated sprint protocols. Meta-analyses consistently show moderate improvements in measures such as maximal strength, sprint performance, and lean body mass, with benefit most pronounced in activities relying on the phosphocreatine energy system. These well-established performance effects are the context in which the trace asks whether creatine also influences cancer outcomes.
context.zh-TW: 補充肌酸是改善高強度、短時間運動表現最有效且文獻記載最完整的增能劑之一。透過增加肌肉磷酸肌酸儲備，肌酸可提升反覆最大強度運動期間再生 ATP 的能力，進而增加功率輸出、阻力訓練中的肌力增長，以及反覆衝刺訓練中的做功量。統合分析一致顯示，肌酸在最大肌力、衝刺表現與去脂體重等指標上帶來中等程度的改善，其效益在依賴磷酸肌酸能量系統的活動中最為顯著。這些確立已久的表現效益，正是該追蹤探討肌酸是否也影響癌症結果的背景脈絡。

context.en-US: Creatine supplementation supports healthy glucose management by enhancing glucose uptake and insulin sensitivity. Mechanistically, creatine prevents the decline of GLUT4 during muscle disuse, increases GLUT4 during rehabilitation, and co-ingestion with carbohydrate or protein augments muscle creatine and glycogen. In individuals with type 2 diabetes, creatine supplementation during exercise training improved glucose tolerance to a standard meal, increased GLUT4 translocation, and lowered HbA1c, with AMPK signaling implicated in these effects. Creatine uptake into tissue is itself influenced by glucose and insulin, establishing a bidirectional relationship between creatine status and glycemic physiology that supports creatine as an adjunct for metabolic health.
context.zh-TW: 補充肌酸可透過增強葡萄糖攝取與胰島素敏感性，支持健康的血糖管理。在機制上，肌酸可防止肌肉廢用期間 GLUT4 的下降，在復健期間增加 GLUT4，而與碳水化合物或蛋白質併服則可增加肌肉肌酸與肝醣。在第二型糖尿病患者中，運動訓練期間補充肌酸可改善對標準餐的葡萄糖耐受度、增加 GLUT4 轉位，並降低 HbA1c，AMPK 訊息傳導被認為與這些效應有關。肌酸進入組織的過程本身也受葡萄糖與胰島素影響，這建立了肌酸狀態與血糖生理之間的雙向關係，支持肌酸作為代謝健康的輔助手段。

context.en-US: Creatine supplementation influences glucose handling in skeletal muscle, in part by upregulating the GLUT4 glucose transporter. Creatine prevents declines in GLUT4 during immobilization and increases GLUT4 by about 40% during rehabilitation after atrophy, and co-ingestion with carbohydrate and protein enhances creatine uptake and muscle glycogen. In type 2 diabetic patients, 12 weeks of creatine supplementation during training improved glucose tolerance, increased GLUT4 translocation, and significantly reduced HbA1c, with changes in AMPK signaling related to GLUT4 translocation and HbA1c. These findings indicate creatine enhances glucose uptake and supports glucose management, especially when combined with exercise.
context.zh-TW: 補充肌酸會影響骨骼肌的葡萄糖處理，部分機制是透過上調 GLUT4 葡萄糖轉運蛋白。肌酸可防止固定不動期間 GLUT4 的下降，並在萎縮後的復健期間使 GLUT4 增加約 40%，而與碳水化合物和蛋白質併服可增強肌酸攝取與肌肉肝醣。在第二型糖尿病患者中，訓練期間補充肌酸 12 週可改善葡萄糖耐受度、增加 GLUT4 轉位，並顯著降低 HbA1c，其中 AMPK 訊息傳導的變化與 GLUT4 轉位及 HbA1c 相關。這些發現顯示肌酸能增強葡萄糖攝取並支持血糖管理，尤其是與運動結合時。

context.en-US: Creatine supplementation increases muscle creatine and phosphocreatine stores and, particularly when combined with resistance training, promotes gains in lean tissue mass and strength. Randomized trials in older adults show greater gains in muscle mass and isometric strength with creatine plus heavy resistance training compared to training alone, and meta-analyses confirm larger gains in muscle mass and upper-body strength in older individuals supplementing creatine during resistance exercise. Creatine also decreases protein breakdown and can preserve muscle mass during energy-restricted weight loss, making it a broadly useful strategy for maintaining muscle across the lifespan and in clinical rehabilitation populations.
context.zh-TW: 補充肌酸可增加肌肉肌酸與磷酸肌酸儲備，尤其是與阻力訓練結合時，能促進去脂組織質量與肌力的增長。在老年人中的隨機試驗顯示，與單獨訓練相比，肌酸加上重度阻力訓練可帶來更大的肌肉質量與等長肌力增長，統合分析也證實，在阻力運動期間補充肌酸的老年人，其肌肉質量與上半身肌力增長更大。肌酸還能減少蛋白質分解，並在限制能量的減重過程中保留肌肉質量，使其成為在整個生命歷程及臨床復健族群中維持肌肉的廣泛實用策略。

context.en-US: Creatine is a naturally occurring nitrogen-containing compound that is synthesized endogenously in the liver, kidney, and pancreas and is also obtained from dietary sources, particularly red meat and fish. Around 95 percent of the body's creatine is stored in skeletal muscle, approximately one-third of it in the phosphorylated form creatine phosphate. In the muscle it is converted to creatine phosphate, which donates its high-energy phosphate group to regenerate ATP from ADP, supporting short-duration, high-intensity exercise. Because of its role in ATP regeneration, creatine is one of the most widely used sports supplements and is increasingly examined for additional therapeutic effects, including possible anti-cancer properties.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸是一種天然存在的含氮化合物，在體內由肝臟、腎臟與胰臟內源性合成，也可從飲食來源獲得，尤其是紅肉與魚類。人體約 95% 的肌酸儲存於骨骼肌，其中約三分之一以磷酸化形式（磷酸肌酸）存在。在肌肉中，肌酸被轉化為磷酸肌酸，後者提供其高能磷酸基團，從 ADP 再生 ATP，以支持短時間、高強度的運動。由於其在 ATP 再生中的角色，肌酸是最廣泛使用的運動補充品之一，並日益被研究是否具有額外的治療效應，包括可能的抗癌特性。

context.en-US: Dietary creatine is obtained almost exclusively from animal-derived foods, with red meat and fish being the richest sources. Cooking does not destroy creatine, and an omnivorous diet typically supplies one to two grams of creatine per day, which complements the roughly one gram synthesized endogenously per day. Vegetarians have lower muscle creatine stores and show larger increases in response to supplementation than meat-eaters, reflecting the lower baseline intake. This dietary origin is relevant to epidemiologic questions about meat consumption and cancer risk, because creatine is often discussed alongside other meat-derived compounds when considering diet-cancer associations.
context.zh-TW: 飲食中的肌酸幾乎完全來自動物性食物，其中紅肉與魚類是最豐富的來源。烹調不會破壞肌酸，雜食性飲食每天通常可提供一至兩公克肌酸，補足體內每天約一公克的內源性合成量。素食者的肌肉肌酸儲備較低，且對補充的反應比肉食者更明顯，反映出其較低的基線攝取量。這種飲食來源與肉類攝取和癌症風險的流行病學問題相關，因為在考量飲食與癌症的關聯時，肌酸常與其他肉類來源化合物一起被討論。

context.en-US: Within cells, creatine is phosphorylated by the enzyme creatine kinase to form creatine phosphate (phosphocreatine), which serves as a rapidly mobilizable reserve of high-energy phosphate. The reaction creatine plus ATP yields creatine phosphate plus ADP, and the reverse reaction regenerates ATP during bursts of high energy demand, such as muscle contraction. The phosphocreatine pool is the immediate energy buffer that sustains ATP levels for the first several seconds of maximal effort, before glycolysis and oxidative metabolism fully contribute. This conversion of creatine to creatine phosphate is the mechanistic heart of the creatine-phosphocreatine energy system.
context.zh-TW: 在細胞內，肌酸由肌酸激酶磷酸化形成磷酸肌酸（phosphocreatine），作為可快速動用的高能磷酸儲備。肌酸加 ATP 的反應產生磷酸肌酸加 ADP，而逆反應則在肌肉收縮等高能量需求爆發期間再生 ATP。磷酸肌酸池是即時的能量緩衝，在糖解作用與氧化代謝完全投入之前，於最大努力的頭幾秒內維持 ATP 濃度。肌酸轉化為磷酸肌酸的過程，正是肌酸—磷酸肌酸能量系統的機制核心。

context.en-US: Roughly two-thirds of the body's creatine pool is phosphorylated and stored as phosphocreatine (PCr), with the remainder held as free creatine. The creatine kinase (CK) reaction interconverts creatine and PCr, and the energy liberated by breaking PCr down into phosphate and creatine (about 10.3 kcal) is used to resynthesize ATP from ADP and inorganic phosphate. This PCr/CK system is the rapid, phosphagen-based buffer that maintains ATP availability during intense exercise, ischemia, hypoxia, and high metabolic demand. Creatine supplementation raises muscle creatine and PCr stores, expanding this reserve and thereby enhancing high-intensity exercise capacity and training adaptations.
context.zh-TW: 人體肌酸池中約有三分之二被磷酸化，以磷酸肌酸（PCr）形式儲存，其餘則以游離肌酸形式存在。肌酸激酶（CK）反應使肌酸與 PCr 相互轉換，而 PCr 分解為磷酸與肌酸所釋放的能量（約 10.3 千卡）用於從 ADP 與無機磷酸再合成 ATP。這個 PCr/CK 系統是快速、以磷酸原為基礎的緩衝機制，可在劇烈運動、缺血、缺氧與高代謝需求期間維持 ATP 的可用性。補充肌酸可提高肌肉肌酸與 PCr 儲備，擴大此能量儲備，進而增強高強度運動能力與訓練適應。

context.en-US: Creatine monohydrate is among the most extensively studied dietary supplements and is generally regarded as safe when used at recommended doses over periods of many years. Long-term supplementation studies report no consistent adverse effects on renal, hepatic, or cardiovascular function in healthy individuals, and creatine is approved for use by many sports organizations. Common minor side effects include water retention and occasional gastrointestinal discomfort. This favorable safety profile is noted in the trace as relevant to the potential evaluation of creatine as an adjunct in oncology settings, where tolerability is a central concern.
context.zh-TW: 一水肌酸是研究最廣泛的膳食補充品之一，在建議劑量下長期使用多年，一般被認為是安全的。長期補充研究報告指出，健康個體的腎臟、肝臟或心血管功能並未出現一致的不良影響，且肌酸已獲許多運動組織核准使用。常見的輕微副作用包括水分滯留與偶發的腸胃不適。該追蹤指出，這種良好的安全性資料與肌酸在腫瘤科情境中作為輔助治療的潛在評估相關，因為耐受性是其中的核心考量。

context.en-US: Approximately 95 percent of the body's creatine is stored in skeletal muscle, where it exists partly as free creatine and partly as creatine phosphate. The muscle creatine pool is maintained by both endogenous synthesis and dietary intake, and it is depleted by high-intensity activity and resynthesized during recovery. Muscle total creatine concentrations can be increased by supplementation, typically by 10-20 percent, and this elevated store extends the time for which high-intensity exercise can be sustained. The predominance of skeletal muscle as a creatine depot explains why most creatine research has focused on muscle function, strength, and performance.
context.zh-TW: 人體約 95% 的肌酸儲存於骨骼肌，其中一部分以游離肌酸形式存在，一部分以磷酸肌酸形式存在。肌肉肌酸池由內源性合成與飲食攝取共同維持，會因高強度活動而耗竭，並在恢復期間重新合成。補充可使肌肉總肌酸濃度增加，通常為 10–20%，而提高的儲備可延長高強度運動得以持續的時間。骨骼肌作為肌酸儲存庫的主導地位，說明了為何大多數肌酸研究都聚焦於肌肉功能、肌力與運動表現。

context.en-US: Creatine is synthesized endogenously from the amino acids arginine, glycine, and methionine in a two-step pathway. The first step, catalyzed by arginine:glycine amidinotransferase (AGAT), takes place primarily in the kidney and pancreas and produces guanidinoacetate; the second step, catalyzed by guanidinoacetate N-methyltransferase (GAMT), transfers a methyl group from S-adenosylmethionine to guanidinoacetate in the liver, producing creatine. This biosynthetic origin connects creatine metabolism to the methylation cycle and one-carbon metabolism, a connection relevant to hypotheses linking creatine status to epigenetic regulation and cancer risk.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸由胺基酸精胺酸、甘胺酸與甲硫胺酸經由兩步驟途徑內源性合成。第一步由精胺酸：甘胺酸脒基轉移酶（AGAT）催化，主要發生在腎臟與胰臟，產生胍基乙酸；第二步由胍基乙酸 N-甲基轉移酶（GAMT）催化，在肝臟中將 S-腺苷甲硫胺酸的甲基轉移至胍基乙酸，產生肌酸。這種生合成來源將肌酸代謝與甲基化循環及一碳代謝連結起來，此關聯與將肌酸狀態連結至表觀遺傳調控與癌症風險的假說相關。

context.en-US: Creatine is a naturally occurring nitrogen-containing compound synthesized endogenously in the body. The first step of its biosynthesis condenses arginine and glycine into guanidinoacetate (GAA), a reaction catalyzed by arginine glycine amidinotransferase (AGAT), which is expressed in the kidney, pancreas, liver, and certain brain regions. Endogenous synthesis supplies roughly half of the daily creatine requirement; the remainder must come from the diet, primarily red meat and fish, or from supplements. Deficiencies in the enzymes of this pathway (AGAT, GAMT) or the creatine transporter produce creatine synthesis deficiency syndromes marked by low brain creatine and neurodevelopmental impairment.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸是一種天然存在的含氮化合物，在體內內源性合成。其生合成的第一步將精胺酸與甘胺酸縮合為胍基乙酸（GAA），此反應由精胺酸甘胺酸脒基轉移酶（AGAT）催化，該酶在腎臟、胰臟、肝臟及某些腦區表現。內源性合成供應每日肌酸需求約一半；其餘部分必須來自飲食（主要是紅肉與魚類）或補充品。此途徑的酶（AGAT、GAMT）或肌酸轉運蛋白缺乏，會導致肌酸合成缺乏症候群，其特徵為腦部肌酸偏低與神經發育受損。

context.en-US: Glycine serves as the second amino acid substrate for endogenous creatine synthesis. Arginine glycine amidinotransferase (AGAT) condenses arginine with glycine to produce guanidinoacetate (GAA), which is then methylated by guanidinoacetate N-methyltransferase (GAMT) using S-adenosyl methionine to yield creatine. Because glycine and arginine are the committed substrates for creatine biosynthesis, their availability influences the rate of endogenous creatine production, which normally covers about half of daily needs. The rest is obtained from dietary red meat, fish, or supplements, and total body creatine stores are typically around 120 mmol/kg of dry muscle mass.
context.zh-TW: 甘胺酸是內源性肌酸合成的第二個胺基酸受質。精胺酸甘胺酸脒基轉移酶（AGAT）將精胺酸與甘胺酸縮合產生胍基乙酸（GAA），隨後由胍基乙酸 N-甲基轉移酶（GAMT）利用 S-腺苷甲硫胺酸將其甲基化，生成肌酸。由於甘胺酸與精胺酸是肌酸生合成的承諾受質，其可用性會影響內源性肌酸生成的速率，而內源性合成通常涵蓋每日需求約一半。其餘部分來自飲食中的紅肉、魚類或補充品，人體總肌酸儲備通常約為每公斤乾燥肌肉質量 120 mmol。

context.en-US: Because endogenous creatine synthesis is the major consumer of methyl groups donated by S-adenosylmethionine, creatine status may influence DNA methylation reactions that govern gene expression, including the expression of oncogenes and tumor suppressors. Supplemental creatine, by reducing the requirement for de novo creatine synthesis, could preserve methyl groups for DNA methyltransferases and thereby modulate global DNA methylation patterns. The trace notes that this is an emerging and largely hypothesis-driven area: creatine's effects on DNA methylation and on one-carbon metabolism have been examined mainly in animal and small human studies, and any causal link to cancer prevention remains to be firmly established.
context.zh-TW: 由於內源性肌酸合成是 S-腺苷甲硫胺酸所提供甲基的主要消耗者，肌酸狀態可能影響調控基因表現的 DNA 甲基化反應，包括致癌基因與腫瘤抑制基因的表現。補充肌酸可降低從頭合成肌酸的需求，從而為 DNA 甲基轉移酶保留甲基，並因此調節整體 DNA 甲基化模式。該追蹤指出，這是一個新興且主要仍以假說驅動的領域：肌酸對 DNA 甲基化與一碳代謝的影響主要在動物與小型人體研究中被檢視，而任何與癌症預防之間的因果關聯仍有待確立。

context.en-US: Creatine and the creatine kinase system are increasingly studied in the context of cancer metabolism. Some cancer types, particularly those with a poor prognosis, upregulate creatine kinase isoenzymes, and creatine metabolism has been reported to support the growth and invasiveness of certain tumors, whereas in other contexts creatine appears to restrain tumor growth, possibly through effects on energy homeostasis and AMPK. The trace explicitly notes that creatine's relationship to cancer is context-dependent and that current evidence is insufficient to recommend creatine as an anti-cancer intervention, underscoring the need for direct experimental studies.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸與肌酸激酶系統在癌症代謝的脈絡中日益受到研究。某些癌症類型，尤其是預後不佳者，會上調肌酸激酶同功酶，且據報導肌酸代謝可支持某些腫瘤的生長與侵襲性；而在其他情境中，肌酸似乎能抑制腫瘤生長，可能透過對能量恆定與 AMPK 的影響。該追蹤明確指出，肌酸與癌症的關係取決於情境，且目前的證據不足以推薦肌酸作為抗癌介入措施，並強調需要直接的實驗研究。

context.en-US: Emerging evidence reviewed in the source trace suggests creatine may exert direct anti-cancer effects, inhibiting tumorigenesis rather than only supporting athletic performance. Mechanistic studies indicate that creatine supplementation can raise cellular phosphocreatine and creatine kinase activity, and the resulting change in the cellular energy state, together with creatine-mediated effects on AMPK and anabolic signaling, may suppress cancer cell proliferation and transformation. Because cancer cells depend on high glycolytic flux and altered energy metabolism, interventions that perturb the creatine-phosphocreatine system are hypothesized to restrain tumor growth, although the trace stresses that much of this evidence is preliminary and requires confirmation in well-powered clinical studies.
context.zh-TW: 來源追蹤所回顧的新興證據顯示，肌酸可能發揮直接的抗癌作用，抑制腫瘤發生而不僅是支持運動表現。機制研究指出，補充肌酸可提高細胞磷酸肌酸與肌酸激酶活性，而隨之而來的細胞能量狀態改變，加上肌酸對 AMPK 與合成代謝訊號的影響，可能抑制癌細胞增殖與轉化。由於癌細胞依賴高糖解通量與改變的能量代謝，擾動肌酸—磷酸肌酸系統的介入措施被假設可抑制腫瘤生長，不過該追蹤強調，這些證據大多仍屬初步，需要在檢定力充足的臨床研究中加以證實。

context.en-US: Creatine supplementation can alter the cellular energy status in ways that modulate AMPK, the central sensor of cellular energy charge. High phosphocreatine and low AMP levels generally suppress AMPK activation, while creatine depletion or energetic stress activates it. Because AMPK regulates anabolic processes, including protein synthesis and cell growth, and influences pathways relevant to cancer metabolism, creatine-induced changes in AMPK signaling are proposed to be one mechanism by which creatine could affect tumor cell proliferation. The trace presents this as a plausible but incompletely validated mechanistic link, noting that AMPK-dependent effects of creatine have been shown mainly in skeletal muscle and liver.
context.zh-TW: 補充肌酸可改變細胞能量狀態，進而調節 AMPK——細胞能量荷電的核心感測器。高磷酸肌酸與低 AMP 濃度通常會抑制 AMPK 活化，而肌酸耗竭或能量壓力則會活化它。由於 AMPK 調控合成代謝過程（包括蛋白質合成與細胞生長），並影響與癌症代謝相關的途徑，肌酸引起的 AMPK 訊號改變被提出為肌酸可能影響腫瘤細胞增殖的機制之一。該追蹤將此呈現為合理但尚未完全驗證的機制關聯，並指出肌酸的 AMPK 依賴性效應主要在骨骼肌與肝臟中獲得證實。

context.en-US: Creatine supplementation has been investigated for its ability to attenuate muscle wasting in conditions of disuse, catabolism, and disease. In healthy subjects it amplifies the muscle gains from resistance training, and in some clinical populations, including elderly individuals and people with neuromuscular or catabolic diseases, creatine supplementation preserves lean mass and strength. Because cancer and its treatments frequently cause sarcopenia and cachexia, creatine's potential to blunt muscle loss is proposed as a supportive-care role for creatine in oncology, even if any direct anti-tumor effect remains unproven.
context.zh-TW: 補充肌酸已被研究其減緩肌肉流失的能力，適用於廢用、分解代謝與疾病狀態。在健康受試者中，肌酸可放大阻力訓練帶來的肌肉增長；而在某些臨床族群中，包括老年人與神經肌肉或分解代謝疾病患者，補充肌酸可保留去脂質量與肌力。由於癌症及其治療常導致肌少症與惡病質，肌酸減緩肌肉流失的潛力被提出為肌酸在腫瘤科中的支持性照護角色，即使任何直接的抗腫瘤效應仍未獲證實。

context.en-US: Creatine and phosphocreatine play an important role in maintaining myocardial bioenergetics during ischemic events, reducing arrhythmias, ischemia-related damage, and improving heart function. Intravenous phosphocreatine prevented accumulation of arrhythmogenic lysophosphoglycerides in the ischemic zone of canine hearts, and adding phosphocreatine to cardioplegic solutions improved myocardial energy availability and reduced arrhythmias. Creatine supplementation also maintains energy availability during brain ischemia and reduces stroke-related damage. Several studies report benefits of oral creatine in chronic heart failure patients in rehabilitation, and phosphocreatine administration is considered a protective strategy for the heart during acute myocardial ischemia.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸與磷酸肌酸在缺血事件期間維持心肌生物能量學方面扮演重要角色，可減少心律不整、缺血相關損傷，並改善心臟功能。靜脈注射磷酸肌酸可防止犬心臟缺血區致心律不整性溶血磷脂甘油酯的累積，而將磷酸肌酸加入心臟麻痺液中可改善心肌能量可用性並減少心律不整。補充肌酸也能在腦缺血期間維持能量可用性，並減少中風相關損傷。多項研究報告口服肌酸對復健中的慢性心臟衰竭患者有益，而投予磷酸肌酸被認為是急性心肌缺血期間保護心臟的策略。

context.en-US: Preclinical studies suggest creatine supplementation can reduce the severity of spinal cord injury. Rats fed creatine before and after moderate spinal cord contusion developed less scar tissue and performed better on locomotor function tests than controls, and rats fed a 2% creatine diet before and after injury experienced less loss of gray matter. In humans with cervical spinal cord injury, creatine supplementation enhanced aerobic exercise capacity, ventilatory anaerobic threshold, and, combined with vitamin D and resistance training, improved arm muscle area, strength, and functional capacity. These findings support creatine as an adjunct that may reduce injury severity and enhance rehabilitation outcomes after spinal cord injury.
context.zh-TW: 臨床前研究顯示，補充肌酸可減輕脊髓損傷的嚴重程度。在中度脊髓挫傷前後餵食肌酸的大鼠，其疤痕組織較少，且在運動功能測試中的表現優於對照組；在損傷前後餵食 2% 肌酸飲食的大鼠，其灰質流失較少。在頸椎脊髓損傷的人類患者中，補充肌酸可增強有氧運動能力與換氣無氧閾值，而與維生素 D 及阻力訓練結合時，可改善手臂肌肉面積、肌力與功能能力。這些發現支持肌酸作為可能減輕損傷嚴重程度並增進脊髓損傷後復健成果的輔助措施。

context.en-US: Creatine supplementation has shown neuroprotective potential in traumatic brain injury. In animal models, providing creatine in the diet for 5 days prior to TBI decreased cortical brain damage by 36% in rats and 50% in mice, an effect attributed to improved energy availability in the injured brain. Creatine also reduces the severity of mild concussions and ischemic brain damage and improves learning and memory during recovery in neonatal mice. While these preclinical studies cannot be replicated in humans, they support the contention that creatine supplementation may reduce the severity of TBI and serve as an adjunctive strategy in individuals at risk of head injury, complementing its established role in muscle and rehabilitation settings.
context.zh-TW: 補充肌酸在創傷性腦損傷中已顯示出神經保護潛力。在動物模型中，於 TBI 前以飲食提供肌酸 5 天，可使大鼠的皮質腦損傷減少 36%、小鼠減少 50%，此效應歸因於受損腦部能量可用性的改善。肌酸也能減輕輕度腦震盪與缺血性腦損傷的嚴重程度，並改善新生小鼠恢復期間的學習與記憶。雖然這些臨床前研究無法在人體中複製，但它們支持肌酸補充可能減輕 TBI 嚴重程度、並作為頭部損傷高風險個體的輔助策略之論點，補足其在肌肉與復健領域中已確立的角色。

context.en-US: Creatine supplementation elevates brain creatine and phosphocreatine, improves brain bioenergetics, and has documented neuroprotective benefits, particularly in response to injury and ischemia. Animal studies show creatine feeding reduces cerebral ischemic brain damage volume by 25-40%, decreases infarct size, and attenuates neuronal death, while human studies report increased brain creatine (9.2% after 7 days), improved corticomotor excitability, and preserved attention during hypoxia. These findings suggest prophylactic creatine may reduce the severity of brain ischemia and stroke-related damage, and it has been investigated as a neuroprotective strategy in pregnancy to improve neonatal outcomes following birth asphyxia.
context.zh-TW: 補充肌酸可提高腦部肌酸與磷酸肌酸濃度、改善腦部生物能量學，並具有文獻記載的神經保護效益，尤其是在損傷與缺血的反應中。動物研究顯示，餵食肌酸可使腦缺血損傷體積減少 25–40%、縮小梗塞面積，並減緩神經元死亡；人體研究則報告腦部肌酸增加（7 天後增加 9.2%）、皮質運動興奮性改善，以及缺氧期間注意力得以維持。這些發現顯示，預防性使用肌酸可能減輕腦缺血與中風相關損傷的嚴重程度，且肌酸已被研究作為懷孕期間的神經保護策略，以改善出生窒息後的新生兒預後。

context.en-US: Creatine provides the immediate phosphate group needed to recycle ADP back into ATP, the cellular energy currency, keeping cellular energy pools saturated and reducing metabolic stress, which protects HRV from plunging during hard training. It is recommended daily at 3-5 grams, ideally post-workout or with the largest carbohydrate meal, because creatine uptake is enhanced by insulin. Pairing creatine with carbohydrates and protein helps drive it into muscle and brain cells more efficiently, with consistency mattering more than exact timing.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸提供將 ADP 回收為 ATP（細胞的能量貨幣）所需的即時磷酸基團，使細胞能量池保持飽和並降低代謝壓力，從而保護 HRV 在艱苦訓練期間不致驟降。建議每日攝取 3–5 公克，理想上在訓練後或搭配最大的一餐碳水化合物，因為胰島素可增強肌酸攝取。將肌酸與碳水化合物和蛋白質搭配，有助於更有效地將其送入肌肉與腦細胞，而持續性比精確的時機更重要。

context.en-US: Creatine has immunomodulatory effects that include reducing pro-inflammatory cytokines such as IL-6 and other inflammatory markers like TNF-alpha and PGE2. A creatine-induced reduction of these inflammatory mediators may help explain some of the neuroprotective benefits observed in patients with central nervous system diseases and the attenuation of inflammatory and muscle damage markers after intense exercise. Creatine also down-regulates expression of toll-like receptors (TLR-2, TLR-3, TLR-4, TLR-7) in a mouse macrophage cell line and may influence cytokines through the NF-kB signaling pathway, with potential consequences for immune response and, notably, for TLR-4-mediated pathology in Parkinson's disease progression.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸具有免疫調節作用，包括降低 IL-6 等促發炎細胞激素，以及 TNF-alpha 與 PGE2 等其他發炎指標。肌酸引起的這些發炎介質降低，可能有助於解釋在中樞神經系統疾病患者身上觀察到的部分神經保護效益，以及劇烈運動後發炎與肌肉損傷指標的減弱。肌酸也會在小鼠巨噬細胞株中下調類鐸受體（TLR-2、TLR-3、TLR-4、TLR-7）的表現，並可能透過 NF-kB 訊息傳導途徑影響細胞激素，對免疫反應具有潛在影響，尤其是對帕金森氏症病程中 TLR-4 媒介的病理機制。

context.en-US: Creatine acts as a direct and indirect antioxidant, in part by coupling to oxidative phosphorylation in mitochondria. Creatine diffuses into mitochondria and, via mitochondrial creatine kinase, couples with ATP produced by oxidative phosphorylation and the adenine nucleotide translocator, after which phosphocreatine diffuses back into the cytosol. This coupling reduces the formation of reactive oxygen species (ROS) by keeping the mitochondrial adenine nucleotide pool well-adenylated and stabilizing electron transport. Consequently creatine supplementation is reported to lower oxidative stress markers, which may contribute to its protective effects on muscle, heart, and brain, particularly under ischemic or metabolically stressed conditions.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸作為直接與間接的抗氧化劑，部分機制是透過與粒線體中的氧化磷酸化偶聯。肌酸擴散進入粒線體，經由粒線體肌酸激酶，與氧化磷酸化產生的 ATP 及腺嘌呤核苷酸轉位酶偶聯，之後磷酸肌酸再擴散回細胞質。這種偶聯使粒線體腺嘌呤核苷酸池保持充分腺苷化並穩定電子傳遞，從而減少活性氧（ROS）的生成。因此，據報導補充肌酸可降低氧化壓力指標，這可能有助於其對肌肉、心臟與腦部的保護作用，尤其是在缺血或代謝受壓力的情況下。

context.en-US: The primary biochemical function of creatine is to buffer cellular ATP levels through the creatine-phosphocreatine system. Creatine kinase reversibly catalyzes the transfer of a phosphoryl group from phosphocreatine to ADP, regenerating ATP at rates far exceeding mitochondrial or glycolytic ATP production, which is essential for short bursts of intense activity. The creatine kinase reaction therefore acts as a rapid temporal energy buffer, maintaining ATP:ADP ratios during muscle contraction and other energy-demanding processes. This ATP-regenerating capacity is the basis for creatine's ergogenic effects and is also central to hypotheses about its influence on cancer cell metabolism.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸的主要生化功能是透過肌酸—磷酸肌酸系統緩衝細胞 ATP 濃度。肌酸激酶可逆地催化磷酸基團從磷酸肌酸轉移至 ADP，以遠超過粒線體或糖解 ATP 產生的速率再生 ATP，這對短暫的劇烈活動爆發至關重要。因此，肌酸激酶反應作為快速的時間性能量緩衝，在肌肉收縮及其他耗能過程中維持 ATP:ADP 比值。這種 ATP 再生能力是肌酸增能效應的基礎，也是關於其對癌細胞代謝影響之假說的核心。

context.en-US: The biological actions of creatine are mediated by the creatine kinase enzyme family, which catalyzes the reversible phosphorylation of creatine by ATP. Tissue-specific creatine kinase isoforms are expressed in muscle, brain, and other tissues, and the enzyme couples the phosphocreatine pool to cellular ATP demand. In tissues with high and fluctuating energy requirements, the creatine kinase reaction buffers ATP levels and transports high-energy phosphate between sites of production and consumption. Because creatine kinase is also expressed in several tumors, the enzyme is a candidate interface through which creatine supplementation could influence cancer cell energy metabolism.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸的生物作用由肌酸激酶酶家族所媒介，該家族催化 ATP 對肌酸的可逆磷酸化。組織特異性的肌酸激酶異構型在肌肉、腦部及其他組織中表現，該酶將磷酸肌酸池與細胞 ATP 需求偶聯。在能量需求高且波動的組織中，肌酸激酶反應可緩衝 ATP 濃度，並在高能磷酸的產生與消耗位置之間進行運輸。由於肌酸激酶也在多種腫瘤中表現，該酶是肌酸補充可能影響癌細胞能量代謝的候選介面。

context.en-US: Creatine and its related compound cyclocreatine have documented anticancer properties. Creatine is an important energy source for immune cells and supports CD8 T cell antitumor immunity, since creatine uptake via the SLC6A8 transporter regulates CD8 T cell function and creatine levels are low in malignant cells and antitumor T cells. Creatine also augments the efficacy of the anticancer medication methylglyoxal, with combined creatine, methylglyoxal, and ascorbic acid eliminating visible signs of tumor growth in experimental models. Evidence is emerging rather than definitive in humans, and creatine is being studied as an adjunct in cancer cachexia and treatment contexts.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸及其相關化合物環肌酸具有文獻記載的抗癌特性。肌酸是免疫細胞的重要能量來源，並支持 CD8 T 細胞的抗腫瘤免疫，因為經由 SLC6A8 轉運蛋白的肌酸攝取會調節 CD8 T 細胞功能，且惡性細胞與抗腫瘤 T 細胞中的肌酸濃度偏低。肌酸也能增強抗癌藥物甲基乙二醛的療效，在實驗模型中，肌酸、甲基乙二醛與抗壞血酸合併使用可消除可見的腫瘤生長跡象。在人體中的證據仍屬新興而非定論，肌酸正被研究作為癌症惡病質與治療情境中的輔助措施。

context.en-US: High-dose, long-term creatine supplementation is a nutritional strategy for creatine synthesis deficiencies caused by mutations in AGAT, GAMT, or the creatine transporter (SLC6A8), which reduce endogenous creatine synthesis or cellular uptake and result in low brain creatine and phosphocreatine. Supplementation at 0.3-0.8 g/kg/day increases brain creatine and PCr levels and improves or stabilizes clinical symptoms including intellectual disability, epilepsy, and movement disorders. Patients with GAMT or AGAT deficiency treated early (e.g., starting at four months of age) can experience normal psychomotor development, and such therapy is well tolerated and may also benefit ornithine aminotransferase deficiency causing gyrate atrophy.
context.zh-TW: 高劑量、長期的肌酸補充是針對 AGAT、GAMT 或肌酸轉運蛋白（SLC6A8）突變所致肌酸合成缺乏症的營養策略，這些突變會降低內源性肌酸合成或細胞攝取，導致腦部肌酸與磷酸肌酸偏低。以每日 0.3–0.8 公克/公斤補充可提高腦部肌酸與 PCr 濃度，並改善或穩定臨床症狀，包括智能障礙、癲癇與動作障礙。早期治療（例如從四個月大開始）的 GAMT 或 AGAT 缺乏症患者可獲得正常的心理動作發展，此療法耐受性良好，且可能對導致迴旋狀萎縮的鳥胺酸胺基轉移酶缺乏症也有益。

context.en-US: Creatine synthesis is the single largest consumer of S-adenosylmethionine-derived methyl groups in the body, using approximately 70 percent of available methyl donor flux. Guanidinoacetate N-methyltransferase transfers a methyl group from S-adenosylmethionine to guanidinoacetate to form creatine, thereby competing with DNA methylation and other methylation reactions for the methyl pool. Because exogenous creatine supplementation reduces the demand for endogenous creatine synthesis, it can spare methyl groups and shift the balance of methylation reactions. This creatine-methionine interaction forms the mechanistic basis for the hypothesis that creatine could influence epigenetic processes relevant to cancer.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸合成是體內 S-腺苷甲硫胺酸衍生甲基的最大單一消耗者，使用約 70% 的可用甲基供應通量。胍基乙酸 N-甲基轉移酶將甲基從 S-腺苷甲硫胺酸轉移至胍基乙酸以形成肌酸，從而與 DNA 甲基化及其他甲基化反應競爭甲基池。由於外源性肌酸補充可降低內源性肌酸合成的需求，因此能節省甲基並改變甲基化反應的平衡。這種肌酸—甲硫胺酸交互作用，構成了肌酸可能影響與癌症相關之表觀遺傳過程此一假說的機制基礎。

context.en-US: Creatine kinase (CK) is the enzyme at the core of the creatine/phosphocreatine energy system. It catalyzes the reversible transfer of a phosphate group between creatine and ADP, using the free energy released from phosphocreatine breakdown (approximately 10.3 kcal) to resynthesize ATP from ADP and inorganic phosphate. This provides a rapid means of replenishing depleted ATP during high-energy-demand states such as intense exercise or conditions where energy production is impaired (ischemia, hypoxia) or insufficient due to increased demand (mental fatigue, disease states). Cytosolic, glycolytic, and mitochondrial CK isoforms cooperate to buffer ATP/ADP ratios and shuttle high-energy phosphate from mitochondria to sites of ATP consumption.
context.zh-TW: 肌酸激酶（CK）是肌酸/磷酸肌酸能量系統核心的酶。它催化磷酸基團在肌酸與 ADP 之間的可逆轉移，利用磷酸肌酸分解所釋放的自由能（約 10.3 千卡），從 ADP 與無機磷酸再合成 ATP。這提供了在高能量需求狀態下快速補充耗竭 ATP 的手段，例如劇烈運動，或能量產生受損（缺血、缺氧）或因需求增加而不足（精神疲勞、疾病狀態）的情況。細胞質、糖解與粒線體 CK 異構型協同作用，以緩衝 ATP/ADP 比值，並將高能磷酸從粒線體穿梭至 ATP 消耗的位置。

subject: Cross-linking

context.en-US: Cross-linking may be responsible for many of the problems of old age, including senile cataract, thickening of the arteries, some cancers and damage to the immune system. A damaged immune system leads to increased susceptibility to infection, and some cancers may arise from the effects of glucose on DNA, which can react with glucose to produce damaged DNA that causes abnormal cells to be produced. Aminoguanidine's ability to prevent cross-linking may help alleviate or prevent senile cataract as well as arterial thickening, kidney failure, thinning bones, osteoarthritis and skin wrinkles.
context.zh-TW: 交聯作用可能是老年許多問題的成因，包括老年性白內障、動脈增厚、某些癌症與免疫系統損傷。受損的免疫系統會導致對感染的易感性增加，而某些癌症可能源於葡萄糖對 DNA 的影響——DNA 可與葡萄糖反應而產生受損的 DNA，進而導致異常細胞的生成。胺基胍防止交聯的能力，可能有助於緩解或預防老年性白內障，以及動脈增厚、腎衰竭、骨質變薄、骨關節炎與皮膚皺紋。

subject: CTPI2

context.en-US: CTPI2, a third-generation SLC25A1 inhibitor, delays the onset of frailty in aged mice as measured by a validated 31-parameter frailty index, alongside improvements in fur condition, coordination, balance and grip strength. In aged tissues, CTPI2 suppresses SASP-associated inflammatory gene expression across skeletal muscle, liver and heart while leaving p16 and p21 unchanged, and circulating inflammatory cytokines are reduced, indicating a systemic attenuation of inflammatory burden. These benefits arise without broad metabolic reprogramming: body weight, composition, metabolic rate, respiratory exchange ratio, activity and lipid metabolic pathways are largely unaffected.
context.zh-TW: CTPI2 是第三代 SLC25A1 抑制劑，可延緩老年小鼠衰弱症的發生，此結果以經驗證的 31 參數衰弱指數衡量，同時伴隨毛皮狀況、協調性、平衡感與握力的改善。在老年組織中，CTPI2 可抑制骨骼肌、肝臟與心臟中與 SASP 相關的發炎基因表現，同時不改變 p16 與 p21，且循環中的發炎細胞激素亦降低，顯示發炎負擔獲得全身性的減輕。這些效益的產生並未伴隨廣泛的代謝重編程：體重、身體組成、代謝率、呼吸交換比、活動量與脂質代謝途徑大多不受影響。

subject: CTPI2

context.en-US: Aged (19-month-old) C57BL/6 mice gavaged with CTPI2 (50 mg/kg three times weekly for 3 months) exhibited more lustrous fur, reduced alopecia and greying, and delayed onset of frailty as measured by a 31-parameter frailty index. Functional assessment revealed enhanced neuromuscular performance: improved coordination and balance (tightrope test), increased strength (hanging and grip strength tests) and preservation of muscle integrity. CTPI2 reduced SASP gene expression in skeletal muscle, liver and heart without altering p16 or p21, indicating that suppressing the mitochondrial citrate-acetyl-CoA axis improves healthspan through SASP modulation rather than senescent cell clearance.
context.zh-TW: 以 CTPI2（50 mg/kg，每週三次，持續 3 個月）管餵的老年（19 個月大）C57BL/6 小鼠，表現出更有光澤的毛皮、脫毛與毛髮灰白減少，且以 31 參數衰弱指數衡量，衰弱症的發生獲得延緩。功能評估顯示神經肌肉表現增強：協調性與平衡感改善（走鋼索測試）、肌力增加（懸掛與握力測試），並保留肌肉完整性。CTPI2 在不改變 p16 或 p21 的情況下，降低了骨骼肌、肝臟與心臟中的 SASP 基因表現，顯示抑制粒線體檸檬酸—乙醯輔酶 A 軸，是透過調節 SASP 而非清除衰老細胞來改善健康壽命。

subject: CTPI2

context.en-US: CTPI2 is a third-generation inhibitor of the mitochondrial citrate carrier SLC25A1 with high binding affinity and specificity. CTPI2 treatment results in dose-dependent suppression of SASP components at transcript and protein levels without altering cell cycle regulators, HMGB1 localization, DNA damage foci or proliferation markers. It reduces global nuclear acetylation and H3K27ac at SASP loci and abolishes incorporation of glucose-derived carbon into histone acetylation, yet does not broadly impair mitochondrial function: OXPHOS gene expression, ATP production, coupling efficiency, mitochondrial ROS and morphology remain largely unchanged.
context.zh-TW: CTPI2 是粒線體檸檬酸載體 SLC25A1 的第三代抑制劑，具有高結合親和力與特異性。CTPI2 治療可在轉錄與蛋白質層面劑量依賴性地抑制 SASP 組成，同時不改變細胞週期調控因子、HMGB1 定位、DNA 損傷焦點或增殖標記。它可降低整體細胞核乙醯化及 SASP 基因座的 H3K27ac，並消除葡萄糖來源碳併入組蛋白乙醯化的現象，但不會廣泛損害粒線體功能：OXPHOS 基因表現、ATP 產生、偶聯效率、粒線體 ROS 與形態大多維持不變。

context.en-US: DELE1, previously identified as a poorly characterized mitochondrial protein from a yeast two-hybrid screen, was converged upon by two independent CRISPR-based screens as the mediator of mitochondrial stress signaling to the ISR. Under mitochondrial stress, the cleaved cytosolic fragment DELE1-S directly binds and activates the heme-regulated kinase HRI. Importantly, HRI activation by DELE1 was shown to be heme-independent, ruling out the classical heme-depletion mechanism. HRI activation in turn leads to eIF2alpha phosphorylation and downstream ATF4 induction, linking mitochondrial dysfunction to the integrated stress response.
context.zh-TW: DELE1 先前在酵母雙雜交篩選中被鑑定為一個特性不明的粒線體蛋白，而兩個獨立的 CRISPR 篩選共同指向它作為粒線體壓力訊號傳遞至 ISR 的媒介。在粒線體壓力下，被切割的細胞質片段 DELE1-S 直接結合並活化血基質調控激酶 HRI。重要的是，DELE1 對 HRI 的活化被證實與血基質無關，排除了經典的血基質耗竭機制。HRI 活化接著導致 eIF2alpha 磷酸化與下游 ATF4 誘導，將粒線體功能障礙與整合性壓力反應連結起來。

subject: Diabetes Mellitus

context.en-US: Diabetes mellitus is often seen as a form of accelerated aging, and the levels of cross-linking products in diabetics are two to three times those of their equivalent normal non-diabetics. Advanced glycation end products are increased in diabetes and play an important role in the development of diabetic complications. Aminoguanidine acts to bind to sugars, preventing them from binding to the lysine groups of proteins, and diabetic clinical trials with humans have highlighted its ability to prevent oxidative modification of LDL, inhibit atherosclerotic plaque formation, reduce albuminuria and delay end-stage renal disease.
context.zh-TW: 糖尿病常被視為一種加速老化的形式，而糖尿病患者體內的交聯產物濃度是年齡相當的正常非糖尿病者的二至三倍。晚期糖化終產物在糖尿病中增加，並在糖尿病併發症的發展中扮演重要角色。胺基胍的作用是與糖結合，防止糖與蛋白質的離胺酸基團結合；人體糖尿病臨床試驗已突顯其預防 LDL 氧化修飾、抑制動脈粥狀硬化斑塊形成、減少白蛋白尿並延緩末期腎病的能力。

subject: DRP1

context.en-US: Cytosolic DRP1 monomers are recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane (OMM) to initiate fission, where they are anchored by four main adaptor proteins: mitochondrial fission factor (MFF), mitochondrial fission 1 protein (FIS1), and mitochondrial dynamics proteins MID49 and MID51. These adaptors physically interact within a DRP1 complex to coordinate fission, and MFF, MID49 and MID51 are directly associated with mitochondrial division; their absence leads to significant mitochondrial elongation. The endoplasmic reticulum and ER-mitochondria contact sites (MAMs) provide a platform for DRP1 oligomerization and constriction of the OMM.
context.zh-TW: 細胞質中的 DRP1 單體被招募至粒線體外膜（OMM）以啟動分裂，並由四個主要接合蛋白錨定：粒線體分裂因子（MFF）、粒線體分裂 1 蛋白（FIS1），以及粒線體動力學蛋白 MID49 與 MID51。這些接合蛋白在 DRP1 複合體中物理性交互作用以協調分裂，其中 MFF、MID49 與 MID51 直接與粒線體分裂相關；它們的缺失會導致粒線體顯著延長。內質網與內質網—粒線體接觸位點（MAMs）為 DRP1 寡聚化及 OMM 的收縮提供平台。

source_document: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

subject: DRP1

context.en-US: DRP1 is recruited from the cytosol to defined sites on the mitochondrial outer membrane, where division occurs. Its adaptor proteins, including MFF, FIS1, MID49, and MID51, serve as receptors that concentrate DRP1 at prospective fission sites, often at positions where mitochondria are already constricted or associated with the endoplasmic reticulum. In cultured cells, MFF recruits DRP1 to the majority of fission events, while MID49 and MID51 recruit DRP1 to mitochondria independently of MFF in certain conditions. Once concentrated, DRP1 oligomerizes into spirals that wrap around the tubule, and GTP hydrolysis drives the membrane constriction required for complete scission.
context.zh-TW: DRP1 從細胞質被招募至粒線體外膜上的特定位置，分裂即在此發生。其接合蛋白（包括 MFF、FIS1、MID49 與 MID51）作為受體，將 DRP1 集中於預定的分裂位點，這些位點通常位於粒線體已收縮或與內質網相關的位置。在培養細胞中，MFF 將 DRP1 招募至大多數的分裂事件，而在某些條件下，MID49 與 MID51 則獨立於 MFF 將 DRP1 招募至粒線體。一旦集中，DRP1 便寡聚化為環繞管狀結構的螺旋，而 GTP 水解驅動完成完全分裂所需的膜收縮。

source_document: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md

subject: DRP1

context.en-US: Biochemical evaluation of Alzheimer's disease (AD) brains demonstrates significantly increased DRP1 and FIS1 and reduced MFN1, MFN2 and OPA1 mRNA and protein levels, correlating with mitochondrial fragmentation and compromised neuronal energy production. Excessive mitochondrial fission interferes with OXPHOS complex assembly and cristae integrity, and S-nitrosylation of DRP1 induced by amyloid beta triggers mitochondrial fission and neuronal damage. Significantly increased DRP1 phosphorylation at Ser616 stimulates DRP1 translocation to mitochondria and fission activity in AD brain, and impaired axonal transport and reduced mitophagy accompany AD progression.
context.zh-TW: 對阿茲海默症（AD）腦部的生化評估顯示，DRP1與FIS1的mRNA及蛋白質表現量顯著增加，而MFN1、MFN2與OPA1則降低，此變化與粒線體碎裂及神經元能量產生受損相關。過度的粒線體分裂會干擾OXPHOS複合體組裝與嵴（cristae）完整性，而由類澱粉蛋白β（amyloid beta）誘發的DRP1 S-亞硝基化則會觸發粒線體分裂與神經元損傷。AD腦中DRP1在Ser616的磷酸化顯著增加，刺激DRP1轉位至粒線體並增強分裂活性，而軸突運輸受損與粒線體自噬（mitophagy）減少伴隨AD病程進展。

source_document: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

context.en-US: Epacadostat is a small-molecule inhibitor of IDO1 tested in clinical trials as an immuno-oncology strategy, often in combination with checkpoint inhibitors targeting PD-1/PD-L1. These combinations aim to relieve IDO1-mediated immunosuppression in the tumor microenvironment by blocking tryptophan depletion and kynurenine production, thereby restoring effector T cell function. However, results from such trials have been mixed, and challenges including isoform selectivity, compensatory pathways (TDO, IDO2), and context-specific effects have limited clinical success.
context.zh-TW: Epacadostat是一種IDO1的小分子抑制劑，已在臨床試驗中作為免疫腫瘤學策略進行測試，常與標靶PD-1/PD-L1的檢查點抑制劑合併使用。這些合併療法旨在透過阻斷色胺酸耗竭與犬尿胺酸（kynurenine）生成，來解除腫瘤微環境中IDO1介導的免疫抑制，從而恢復效應T細胞功能。然而，此類試驗的結果好壞參半，包括異構體選擇性、代償途徑（TDO、IDO2）與情境依賴性效應等挑戰，限制了臨床上的成功。

subject: Everolimus

context.en-US: Two randomized placebo-controlled clinical trials tested rapalogs among the elderly for immunomodulation. Treatment with everolimus monotherapy or everolimus in combination with RTB101 for six weeks resulted in a better response to influenza vaccine and fewer infections over the next year compared to placebo. The proposed mechanism is an increase in autophagy through inhibition of mTOR along with increased expression of antiviral proteins. The observation that immune function improves after a single six-week period of mTORC1 inhibition has important clinical implications, since elderly patients are particularly at risk of dying from influenza.
context.zh-TW: 兩項隨機、安慰劑對照的臨床試驗在老年族群中測試了rapalog的免疫調節作用。與安慰劑相比，單用everolimus或以everolimus合併RTB101治療六週，可獲得較佳的流感疫苗反應，並在接下來一年內減少感染次數。其提出的機制是透過抑制mTOR來增加自噬（autophagy），同時增加抗病毒蛋白的表現。僅單次六週的mTORC1抑制即可改善免疫功能，此觀察具有重要的臨床意義，因為老年患者特別容易因流感而死亡。

source_document: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md

subject: Everolimus

context.en-US: Everolimus, a rapamycin analog (rapalog), is FDA approved for anti-seizure therapy in tuberous sclerosis complex after many years of off-label use. The EXIST-3 multicenter phase III study evaluated adjunctive everolimus in patients with treatment-resistant epilepsy due to TSC and showed significant reduction in seizure frequency, with approximately 40% of patients in the high-dose group achieving at least a 50% reduction in seizures compared to only 15% in placebo. The success reflects TSC's clearly defined molecular etiology, with highly penetrant mutations driving mTOR hyperactivation making the pathway an actionable target.
context.zh-TW: Everolimus是雷帕黴素類似物（rapalog），在多年仿單外使用後，獲FDA核准用於結節性硬化症（tuberous sclerosis complex）的抗癲癇治療。EXIST-3多中心第三期研究評估everolimus作為輔助治療用於因TSC導致難治性癲癇的患者，結果顯示癲癇發作頻率顯著降低，高劑量組約有40%的患者癲癇發作減少至少50%，而安慰劑組僅15%。此成功反映了TSC明確的分子病因學，高外顯率的突變驅動mTOR過度活化，使該路徑成為可施作的治療標靶。

source_document: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md

context.en-US: Excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), also known as the afterburn effect, is the elevated oxygen consumption that persists after an exercise session and represents the energy expended in excess of resting values during recovery. EPOC accounts for a portion of the total energy cost of exercise beyond the exercise itself, typically contributing an additional 7-15 percent of the exercise energy cost depending on intensity and duration. Because EPOC elevates the metabolic rate for hours after training, it is often cited to justify high-intensity training for weight management, although Speakman's analysis argues that the quantitative contribution to total daily expenditure is smaller than commonly claimed.
context.zh-TW: 運動後過量耗氧（EPOC），又稱後燃效應（afterburn effect），是指運動結束後持續存在的升高耗氧量，代表恢復期間超過靜止值的能量消耗。EPOC佔運動總能量成本中運動本身之外的一部分，依強度與持續時間不同，通常額外貢獻運動能量成本的7–15%。由於EPOC在訓練後數小時內會提升代謝率，常被引用來支持以高強度訓練進行體重管理，儘管Speakman的分析主張其對每日總能量消耗的量化貢獻比常見宣稱來得小。

context.en-US: Exercise causes a transient but significant elevation of resting metabolic rate that outlasts the exercise bout itself. A number of studies show RMR is increased for at least 24-48 hours following vigorous exercise, and residual increases are detectable even up to 3 days after a single session in some protocols. The elevation appears largely independent of the intensity of the exercise, with high-intensity interval exercise providing comparable post-exercise energy expenditure to continuous moderate exercise when matched for work. This post-exercise elevation is one mechanism by which physical activity raises daily energy expenditure beyond the direct cost of the exercise itself.
context.zh-TW: 運動會引起短暫但顯著的靜止代謝率升高，且持續時間超過運動本身。多項研究顯示，劇烈運動後至少24–48小時內RMR會升高，在某些實驗方案中，單次運動後殘餘升高甚至可偵測至3天。此升高似乎大致與運動強度無關，在總作功量匹配下，高強度間歇運動與連續中等強度運動所提供的運動後能量消耗相當。這種運動後升高是身體活動在運動本身直接成本之外提高每日能量消耗的機制之一。

context.en-US: Exercise raises total daily energy expenditure (TEE) through several mechanisms acting together: the direct metabolic cost of the exercise bout itself, the elevated resting metabolic rate and excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) that persist after the session, and increases in nonexercise activity thermogenesis and appetite in some individuals. Speakman uses doubly labelled water studies to show that while athletes have high TEE, the contribution of exercise to TEE in moderately active people is modest in magnitude, and that an exercise-induced rise in TEE of 10-15 percent is not necessarily compensated by reduced activity in other parts of the day.
context.zh-TW: 運動透過多種機制共同提高每日總能量消耗（TEE）：運動本身的直接代謝成本、運動後持續的靜止代謝率升高與運動後過量耗氧（EPOC），以及部分個體中非運動性活動產熱與食慾的增加。Speakman利用雙標水研究顯示，雖然運動員具有高TEE，但對中等活動量的人而言，運動對TEE的貢獻幅度有限，而且運動引起的TEE上升10–15%並不一定會被一天中其他時段的活動減少所抵銷。

context.en-US: Exercise is defined as planned, structured, and repetitive physical activity performed specifically to improve or maintain physical fitness, and it constitutes a subset of total physical activity, which also includes occupational activity, domestic activity, and non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT). In the energy balance framework of the Speakman review, exercise is the most flexible and controllable component of total daily energy expenditure, and its contribution to daily energy use is quantified through doubly labelled water studies. Because exercise is a voluntary component, it is the primary target of public-health interventions aimed at raising daily energy expenditure.
context.zh-TW: 運動被定義為有計畫、有結構且重複的身體活動，專門為了改善或維持體能而進行；它是總身體活動的一部分，後者還包括職業活動、家務活動與非運動性活動產熱（NEAT）。在Speakman綜述的能量平衡架構中，運動是每日總能量消耗中最具彈性且最可控制的部分，其對每日能量使用的貢獻可透過雙標水研究加以量化。由於運動是自願性組成，它是旨在提高每日能量消耗的公共衛生介入的主要目標。

context.en-US: An important conclusion of the Speakman review is that exercise does not reliably increase appetite, and that in many individuals appetite is suppressed both during and for a period after exercise, an effect that can persist for up to 24 hours in some protocols. This is counter to the common belief that increased exercise necessarily drives increased food intake. When exercise does raise energy intake, the increase is generally smaller than the energy cost of the exercise, so a net negative energy balance is usually achieved. These findings support the view that exercise contributes to weight control by raising expenditure without a fully compensatory increase in intake.
context.zh-TW: Speakman綜述的一項重要結論是，運動並不會可靠地增加食慾，而且在許多個體中，食慾在運動期間及運動後一段時間內受到抑制，在某些實驗方案中此效應可持續長達24小時。這與「增加運動必然驅動更多食物攝取」的常見信念相反。當運動確實提高能量攝取時，其增加量通常小於運動的能量成本，因此通常可達到淨負能量平衡。這些發現支持以下觀點：運動透過提高消耗、而無完全補償性的攝取增加，來促進體重控制。

context.en-US: Physical exercise is proposed as a low-cost, non-pharmacological means to stimulate mitohormesis. Rodent models show that exercise stimulates a UPRmt response in muscle and other tissues, and mitokines including GDF15 and MOTS-c are markedly stimulated by exercise, suggesting the potential to exploit these factors as exercise mimetics. However, too much exercise in humans actually impairs mitochondrial function, reduces ROS production, and worsens metabolic health, underscoring that the hormetic benefit of exercise depends on an appropriate dose and adequate recovery.
context.zh-TW: 身體運動被提出作為一種低成本、非藥理學的手段來刺激粒線體毒物興奮效應（mitohormesis）。囓齒類模型顯示，運動會在肌肉及其他組織中刺激UPRmt反應，而包括GDF15與MOTS-c在內的粒線體激素（mitokine）會因運動而顯著受到刺激，顯示這些因子有潛力被開發為運動模擬劑。然而，對人類而言，過度運動實際上會損害粒線體功能、降低ROS產生並惡化代謝健康，這凸顯運動的毒物興奮效益取決於適當劑量與充足恢復。

context.en-US: Intermittent fasting and time-restricted feeding compress the eating window to 8-10 hours to allow a 14-16 hour daily fasting period, described as the simplest and most effective way to activate AMPK and mitophagy. Constant snacking and chronic overeating abolish the fasting-induced AMPK signal necessary for mitophagy. Fasting-induced mitochondrial recycling is a core mitohormetic mechanism, and stopping food intake at least 3-4 hours before sleep is highlighted as a key variable that instantly improves overnight HRV by allowing the body to focus entirely on cellular repair during sleep.
context.zh-TW: 間歇性斷食與限時進食將進食窗口壓縮至8–10小時，以達到每天14–16小時的禁食期，被描述為活化AMPK與粒線體自噬最簡單且最有效的方法。持續零嘴進食與慢性暴食會消除禁食誘發、粒線體自噬所需的AMPK訊號。禁食誘導的粒線體回收是核心的粒線體毒物興奮機制，而至少在睡前3–4小時停止進食被強調為關鍵變因，可讓身體在睡眠期間完全專注於細胞修復，立即改善夜間HRV。

context.en-US: Fat free mass (FFM) is the single best predictor of resting metabolic rate (RMR), explaining the majority of inter-individual variation in energy expenditure at rest. In the doubly labelled water and metabolic chamber studies reviewed by Speakman, FFM correlates with RMR with correlations typically above 0.7, with lean tissue contributing proportionally more than fat mass. The relationship reflects the high metabolic activity of lean tissues, especially the brain, liver, and skeletal muscle at rest. Consequently, any intervention that changes FFM, such as resistance training, is expected to alter RMR in proportion, though adaptive changes in metabolic efficiency can partially blunt this effect.
context.zh-TW: 去脂體重（FFM）是靜止代謝率（RMR）的最佳單一預測因子，可解釋靜止狀態下能量消耗的大部分個體間差異。在Speakman回顧的雙標水與代謝艙研究中，FFM與RMR的相關性通常高於0.7，且瘦肉組織的貢獻比例上高於脂肪量。此關係反映了瘦肉組織（尤其是腦、肝臟與骨骼肌）在靜止時的高代謝活性。因此，任何改變FFM的介入（如阻力訓練）預期會成比例地改變RMR，儘管代謝效率的適應性改變可能部分削弱此效應。

subject: Ferroptosis

context.en-US: Ferroptosis is a regulated, iron-dependent cell death pathway in which cells lose their ability to regulate fats and eventually die, as distinct from unregulated necrotic death or other programmed death programs like apoptosis. It was discovered and named (originally 'oxytosis') by Pam Maher in 2001. The hallmark mechanism is accumulation of lipid peroxides to toxic levels, normally kept in check by glutathione, and the pathway is increasingly linked to neurodegeneration and age-related diseases. Because ferroptosis is druggable and genetically regulatable, it has become a promising therapeutic target alongside cellular senescence for supporting healthy aging and clearing dysfunctional cells.
context.zh-TW: 鐵依賴性細胞死亡（ferroptosis）是一種受調控、依賴鐵的細胞死亡途徑，細胞在此途徑中失去調節脂肪的能力並最終死亡，有別於不受調控的壞死性死亡或其他如細胞凋亡（apoptosis）的程式性死亡。它由Pam Maher於2001年發現並命名（最初稱為「oxytosis」）。其標誌性機制是脂質過氧化物累積至毒性濃度，此過程通常由麩胱甘肽（glutathione）加以控制，且此途徑日益與神經退化及年齡相關疾病相關。由於ferroptosis可被藥物調控且在遺傳上可調節，它與細胞衰老（cellular senescence）一同成為支持健康老化與清除功能失常細胞的具前景治療標靶。

subject: Ferroptosis

context.en-US: Ferroptosis is an iron-dependent cell death pathway in which the accumulation of lipid peroxides becomes toxic to cells. Pam Maher, the Salk senior author, discovered the pathway and named it (originally 'oxytosis') in 2001. Healthy cells keep lipid peroxides at steady levels with the help of glutathione, an antioxidant that can stave off ferroptosis. Ferroptosis has been increasingly linked to neurodegeneration - Maher's lab recently reported that chronic iron overexposure in neurons makes them less resilient over time and more vulnerable to neurodegeneration - and targeting the pathway has become a promising therapeutic strategy for age-related diseases alongside senescence research.
context.zh-TW: Ferroptosis是一種依賴鐵的細胞死亡途徑，其中脂質過氧化物的累積對細胞產生毒性。Salk研究所的資深作者Pam Maher於2001年發現此途徑並加以命名（最初稱為「oxytosis」）。健康細胞在麩胱甘肽（一種可抵禦ferroptosis的抗氧化劑）的幫助下，將脂質過氧化物維持在穩定水平。Ferroptosis日益與神經退化相關——Maher的實驗室近期報告指出，神經元長期過度暴露於鐵會使其隨時間韌性下降，並更容易發生神經退化——而標靶此途徑已與衰老研究一同成為年齡相關疾病的具前景治療策略。

source_document: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md

subject: Ferroptosis

context.en-US: Ferroptosis is a regulated cell death pathway driven by the toxic accumulation of lipid peroxides. Cells die in ferroptosis when they lose the ability to regulate fats, and polyunsaturated fatty acids in membranes become the substrates for peroxidative damage. Healthy cells keep lipid peroxides at steady levels with the help of glutathione, an antioxidant that staves off ferroptosis. The pathway is iron-dependent and has been linked to aging and neurodegeneration, including Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease. Understanding lipid-peroxide accumulation as the central executioner mechanism explains why membrane lipid remodeling - such as that caused by acid ceramidase - can sensitize cells to ferroptosis.
context.zh-TW: Ferroptosis是一種受調控的細胞死亡途徑，由脂質過氧化物的毒性累積所驅動。當細胞失去調節脂肪的能力時，便會死於ferroptosis，而膜中的多元不飽和脂肪酸成為過氧化損傷的受質。健康細胞在麩胱甘肽（一種可抵禦ferroptosis的抗氧化劑）的幫助下，將脂質過氧化物維持在穩定水平。此途徑依賴鐵，並已被連結至老化與神經退化，包括阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症。理解脂質過氧化物累積作為核心執行者機制，說明了為何膜脂質重塑——例如由酸性神經醯胺酶（acid ceramidase）所引起的重塑——能使細胞對ferroptosis敏感化。
