context.en-US: FGF21 induces thermogenesis and promotes energy expenditure through UCP1-dependent mechanisms. FGF21 promotes thermogenic beiging of white adipose tissue, with protein restriction stimulating WAT beiging via FGF21 action in the brain through sympathetic signaling, and PR similarly increases thermogenesis in brown adipose tissue via an FGF21-dependent mechanism. These effects drive the increased energy expenditure observed with protein restriction and contribute to its metabolic benefits including reduced body weight and adiposity despite increased food intake. FGF21 also regulates lipid homeostasis, reducing circulating triglycerides, and mediates PR effects on senescence and inflammation in white adipose tissue.
context.zh-TW: FGF21透過UCP1依賴性機制誘發產熱並促進能量消耗。FGF21促進白色脂肪組織的產熱性米色化（beiging），而蛋白質限制會經由腦中FGF21的作用、透過交感神經訊號刺激WAT米色化；PR同樣透過FGF21依賴性機制增加棕色脂肪組織的產熱。這些效應驅動了蛋白質限制所觀察到的能量消耗增加，並促成其代謝益處，包括在食物攝取增加的情況下仍降低體重與脂肪量。FGF21也調節脂質恆定、降低循環三酸甘油酯，並中介PR對白色脂肪組織中衰老與發炎的效應。

context.en-US: FGF21 is essential for the longevity and many of the metabolic benefits of protein restriction. Fgf21-null mice do not live longer on PR, while mice overexpressing Fgf21 show ~30-40% lifespan extension, identifying FGF21 as the critical downstream mediator. FGF21 promotes energy expenditure in part through UCP1-dependent thermogenic beiging of white adipose tissue, acting in the brain through sympathetic signaling, and increases thermogenesis in brown adipose tissue. It also regulates lipid homeostasis, reduces circulating triglycerides, mediates PR effects on cellular senescence and inflammation in white adipose tissue, and reduces hepatic steatosis, inflammation, and fibrosis in obese models.
context.zh-TW: FGF21對於蛋白質限制的長壽效應及其許多代謝益處至關重要。Fgf21基因剔除小鼠在PR下並不會活得更久，而過度表現Fgf21的小鼠則顯示約30–40%的壽命延長，使FGF21被確認為關鍵的下游媒介者。FGF21部分透過UCP1依賴性的白色脂肪組織產熱性米色化促進能量消耗，其作用發生於腦中並經由交感神經訊號傳遞，同時也增加棕色脂肪組織的產熱。它還調節脂質恆定、降低循環三酸甘油酯、中介PR對白色脂肪組織中細胞衰老與發炎的效應，並在肥胖模型中減少肝臟脂肪變性、發炎與纖維化。

subject: FIS1

context.en-US: FIS1 is a tail-anchored outer mitochondrial membrane protein that functions as a receptor for DRP1, helping to recruit the fission machinery to mitochondria. In yeast, the FIS1 ortholog Fis1p is the main membrane anchor for the Dnm1p fission GTPase, whereas in mammalian cells FIS1 plays a more accessory role alongside MFF, MID49, and MID51, and may also mediate non-DRP1 functions such as recruiting proteasomal and autophagic machinery to mitochondria. Overexpression of FIS1 fragments mitochondria, whereas FIS1 knockdown produces elongated networks, confirming its pro-fission role, although its relative importance varies between cell types and conditions.
context.zh-TW: FIS1是一種錨定於粒線體外膜的蛋白質（tail-anchored protein），作為DRP1的受體，協助將分裂機製招募至粒線體。在酵母菌中，FIS1的直系同源物Fis1p是分裂GTP酶Dnm1p的主要膜錨點；而在哺乳類細胞中，FIS1則與MFF、MID49及MID51一同扮演較輔助性的角色，也可能中介非DRP1的功能，例如將蛋白酶體與自噬機製招募至粒線體。FIS1過度表現會使粒線體碎裂，而FIS1基因敲低則產生延長狀的網絡，證實其促分裂作用，儘管其相對重要性會因細胞類型與條件而異。

source_document: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin is a potent antioxidant that scavenges reactive oxygen species (ROS) and reactive nitrogen species and stimulates endogenous antioxidant defenses including Nrf2-dependent expression of heme oxygenase-1, catalase, and superoxide dismutase. Its multiple hydroxyl groups allow it to donate electrons to quench free radicals and chelate metal ions that catalyze oxidative damage. The anti-oxidative action of fisetin underpins its protective effects in neuronal, cardiac, hepatic, and renal models of oxidative stress, and is considered a core mechanism shared with other polyphenols in its protective pharmacology.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin是一種強效抗氧化劑，可清除活性氧物種（ROS）與活性氮物種，並刺激內源性抗氧化防禦，包括Nrf2依賴性的血基質氧化酶-1（heme oxygenase-1）、過氧化氫酶與超氧化物歧化酶表現。其多個羥基使其能捐贈電子以淬滅自由基，並螯合催化氧化損傷的金屬離子。fisetin的抗氧化作用是其於神經、心臟、肝臟與腎臟氧化壓力模型中保護效應的基礎，並被認為是其保護性藥理學中與其他多酚類共有的核心機制。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin is among the most extensively studied naturally occurring senolytics. It selectively eliminates senescent cells by inhibiting key pro-survival pathways, including the PI3K/Akt and Bcl-xL pathways that senescent cells depend on to resist apoptosis. In aged mice, a short course of oral fisetin reduced senescent cell burden in multiple tissues, extended healthspan and median lifespan, and alleviated age-related dysfunction. This senolytic activity distinguishes fisetin from many flavonoids and has driven its evaluation in human clinical trials for osteoarthritis, frailty, and other age-related conditions, though pharmacokinetic limitations remain a central obstacle.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin是研究最廣泛的天然衰老細胞清除劑（senolytic）之一。它透過抑制衰老細胞賴以抵抗凋亡的關鍵促存活途徑（包括PI3K/Akt與Bcl-xL途徑），選擇性地清除衰老細胞。在老年小鼠中，短期口服fisetin可降低多種組織中的衰老細胞負擔、延長健康壽命（healthspan）與中位壽命，並緩解年齡相關的功能失調。此senolytic活性使fisetin有別於許多黃酮類化合物，並驅動其進入針對骨關節炎、衰弱及其他年齡相關疾病的人類臨床試驗，儘管藥代動力學限制仍是核心障礙。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin shows broad anti-cancer activity against cell lines derived from lung, colon, breast, prostate, liver, melanoma, bladder, and leukemia. It inhibits cancer cell proliferation by arresting the cell cycle at G1 or G2/M phase, induces apoptosis through the intrinsic mitochondrial pathway with activation of caspases and modulation of Bcl-2 family proteins, and suppresses invasion and metastasis by inhibiting matrix metalloproteinases and epithelial-mesenchymal transition. Fisetin also sensitizes tumor cells to conventional chemotherapeutics. Its anti-cancer efficacy in animal models, however, has been limited by the low concentrations achieved after oral dosing.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin對源自肺、結腸、乳、前列腺、肝、黑色素瘤、膀胱與白血病的細胞株展現廣泛的抗癌活性。它透過將細胞週期阻斷於G1或G2/M期來抑制癌細胞增殖，經由內在粒線體途徑誘發凋亡（伴隨caspase活化與Bcl-2家族蛋白調節），並透過抑制基質金屬蛋白酶與上皮-間質轉換來抑制侵襲與轉移。Fisetin也會使腫瘤細胞對傳統化療藥物敏感化。然而，其動物模型中的抗癌效力受到口服給藥後僅達低濃度所限制。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin improves glucose homeostasis in experimental diabetes by enhancing insulin sensitivity and reducing hepatic glucose output. In diabetic rodents it lowers fasting blood glucose and glycated hemoglobin, reduces insulin resistance, and protects pancreatic beta cells, in part through its antioxidant activity and activation of AMPK signaling in liver and muscle. The review notes these metabolic benefits depend on adequate systemic exposure, which the oral delivery of unformulated fisetin may not achieve, further emphasizing the need for bioavailability-improving formulations to realize its therapeutic potential in humans.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin透過提高胰島素敏感性與減少肝臟葡萄糖輸出，改善實驗性糖尿病的葡萄糖恆定。在糖尿病囓齒類中，它降低空腹血糖與糖化血色素、減少胰島素阻抗，並保護胰臟β細胞，部分透過其抗氧化活性與活化肝臟及肌肉中的AMPK訊號。該綜述指出，這些代謝益處取決於足夠的全身暴露量，而未經配方處理的fisetin口服給藥可能無法達成，進一步強調需要能改善生體可用率的配方，才能實現其於人體的治療潛力。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin is incompletely and variably absorbed after oral administration due to its low water solubility and rapid first-pass metabolism by intestinal and hepatic conjugating enzymes. Bioavailability studies report low and highly variable plasma fisetin concentrations after oral dosing, with most of the absorbed compound present as glucuronide and sulfate conjugates rather than the parent aglycone. The review identifies this limited oral absorption as the principal barrier to clinical translation of fisetin's broad preclinical pharmacology, and the majority of the formulation strategies it discusses are specifically aimed at increasing the fraction of the orally administered dose that reaches the systemic circulation unchanged.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin口服給藥後的吸收不完全且變異大，原因在於其低水溶性，以及腸道與肝臟接合酶快速的首次通過代謝。生體可用率研究報告指出，口服給藥後血漿fisetin濃度低且高度變異，大部分被吸收的化合物以葡萄糖醛酸（glucuronide）與硫酸（sulfate）接合物形式存在，而非母體苷元（aglycone）。該綜述將此有限的口服吸收認定為fisetin廣泛臨床前藥理學轉譯的主要障礙，而其討論的大部分配方策略均專門針對提高口服劑量中未經改變即到達全身循環的比例。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin has extremely low water solubility, reported in the range of a few micrograms per milliliter, which classifies it as a Biopharmaceutics Classification System (BCS) class II or IV drug. The low solubility, combined with poor permeability in some assessments and extensive intestinal and hepatic first-pass metabolism, results in low and erratic oral bioavailability. Because dissolution is the rate-limiting step for oral absorption, much of the formulation research described in the review aims to increase the dissolution rate and apparent solubility of fisetin, using approaches such as solid dispersions, cyclodextrin inclusion complexes, and nanocrystals.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin的水溶性極低，報告值約為每毫升數微克，使其被歸類為生物藥劑學分類系統（BCS）第II類或第IV類藥物。低溶解度加上部分評估中較差的通透性，以及廣泛的腸道與肝臟首次通過代謝，導致低且不穩定的口服生體可用率。由於溶離是口服吸收的速率決定步驟，該綜述所述的大部分配方研究旨在提高fisetin的溶離速率與表觀溶解度，使用固體分散、環糊精包合物與奈米晶體等方法。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin exerts neuroprotective effects that are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and direct signaling actions in neurons. It protects cultured neurons from oxidative and excitotoxic insults, and in animal models of ischemia and Parkinson's disease it reduces neuronal loss and improves motor function. Fisetin also acts as a cognitive enhancer, improving learning and memory in healthy rodents through modulation of ERK-CREB signaling and by promoting synaptic plasticity, and it has been proposed as a candidate for Alzheimer's disease based on its ability to reduce beta-amyloid aggregation and tau pathology. These effects motivate delivery strategies aimed at improving brain exposure.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin發揮的神經保護效應歸因於其在神經元中的抗氧化、抗發炎與直接訊號傳導作用。它能保護培養神經元免受氧化與興奮性毒性傷害，且在缺血與帕金森氏症動物模型中減少神經元損失並改善運動功能。Fisetin也作為認知增強劑，透過調節ERK-CREB訊號並促進突觸可塑性，改善健康囓齒類的學習與記憶；基於其減少β-類澱粉蛋白聚集與tau病理的能力，也被提出作為阿茲海默症的候選藥物。這些效應推動了旨在提高腦部暴露量的給藥策略。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin suffers from intrinsically poor bioavailability that restricts its clinical translation. Its water solubility is very low (below 10 ug/mL), and the compound is sensitive to light, heat, and oxidative degradation. After oral administration fisetin is rapidly metabolized in the gut and liver to glucuronide and sulfate conjugates, so systemic exposure of the parent compound is minimal. The review documents that oral fisetin has short half-life and low plasma concentrations, and it attributes these problems to the BCS class II/IV characteristics of fisetin, motivating the development of macro- and nano-formulations to improve its absorption.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin受到本質上較差的生體可用率所苦，這限制了其臨床轉譯。其水溶性非常低（低於10 ug/mL），且此化合物對光、熱與氧化降解敏感。口服給藥後，fisetin在腸道與肝臟中迅速代謝為葡萄糖醛酸與硫酸接合物，因此母體化合物的全身暴露量極小。該綜述記載口服fisetin的半衰期短、血漿濃度低，並將這些問題歸因於fisetin的BCS第II/IV類特性，促使開發巨觀與奈米配方以改善其吸收。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin targets the anti-apoptotic protein Bcl-xL, which is overexpressed in many cancer cells and in senescent cells as a survival mechanism. By inhibiting Bcl-xL and the related pro-survival pathways PI3K/Akt, fisetin lowers the threshold for apoptosis, promoting the death of senescent cells and chemoresistant cancer cells. The reliance of senescent cells on Bcl-xL is precisely the vulnerability that senolytics exploit, and fisetin's capacity to inhibit Bcl-xL is a key mechanistic basis for its senolytic activity and for its ability to sensitize tumors to existing therapies.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin標靶抗凋亡蛋白Bcl-xL，該蛋白在許多癌細胞與衰老細胞中作為存活機制而過度表現。透過抑制Bcl-xL及相關的促存活途徑PI3K/Akt，fisetin降低了凋亡的閾值，促進衰老細胞與化療抗性癌細胞的死亡。衰老細胞對Bcl-xL的依賴正是senolytic所利用的弱點，而fisetin抑制Bcl-xL的能力是其senolytic活性及其使腫瘤對既有療法敏感化的關鍵機制基礎。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin suppresses inflammation through multiple converging mechanisms. It inhibits the NF-kB pathway, reducing the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6, and it inhibits cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) and inducible nitric oxide synthase, decreasing prostaglandin and nitric oxide levels. It also blocks the STAT1 and STAT3 signaling cascades that amplify inflammatory gene expression. These anti-inflammatory actions contribute to fisetin's protective effects in arthritis, colitis, acute lung injury, and neuroinflammation models, and the anti-inflammatory activity is preserved in some nanoformulations of the compound.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin透過多種匯聚機制抑制發炎。它抑制NF-kB途徑，減少TNF-alpha、IL-1beta與IL-6等促發炎細胞激素的產生，並抑制環氧合酶-2（COX-2）與誘導型一氧化氮合酶，降低前列腺素與一氧化氮水平。它也阻斷放大發炎基因表現的STAT1與STAT3訊號級聯。這些抗發炎作用促成fisetin在關節炎、結腸炎、急性肺損傷與神經發炎模型中的保護效應，且此抗發炎活性在該化合物的一些奈米配方中得以保留。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin belongs to the pharmacological class of senolytics, agents that selectively kill senescent cells. Senolytics, exemplified by fisetin and dasatinib plus quercetin, exploit the reliance of senescent cells on anti-apoptotic survival networks. Fisetin's senolytic profile was identified in screening studies and validated in mouse models where it cleared senescent cells in adipose tissue, bone marrow, and other organs and extended healthspan. Because senescent cell accumulation drives tissue dysfunction and age-related disease, fisetin is now being evaluated in human trials, and its classification as a senolytic frames the therapeutic rationale for improving its bioavailability.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin屬於senolytic（衰老細胞清除劑）藥理學類別，即選擇性殺死衰老細胞的藥物。以fisetin及dasatinib加quercetin為代表的senolytic，利用衰老細胞對抗凋亡存活網絡的依賴。Fisetin的senolytic特性在篩選研究中被識別，並在小鼠模型中獲得驗證：它清除脂肪組織、骨髓及其他器官中的衰老細胞，並延長健康壽命。由於衰老細胞累積驅動組織功能失調與年齡相關疾病，fisetin目前正在人體試驗中評估，而其作為senolytic的分類也為改善其生體可用率的治療學理提供框架。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin (3,3',4',7-tetrahydroxyflavone) is a natural flavonoid of the flavonol subclass found in strawberries, apples, persimmons, onions, and cucumbers, with strawberries being the richest dietary source. It has the molecular formula C15H10O6 and a molecular weight of 286.24 g/mol. Fisetin is widely studied as a senolytic agent, and its anti-oxidative, anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and neuroprotective activities are reported in numerous in vitro and in vivo studies. Despite its broad pharmacological potential, fisetin has extremely poor aqueous solubility, which severely limits its oral bioavailability.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin（3,3',4',7-四羥基黃酮）是黃酮醇亞類的天然黃酮類化合物，存在於草莓、蘋果、柿子、洋蔥與黃瓜中，其中草莓是最豐富的膳食來源。其分子式為C15H10O6，分子量為286.24 g/mol。Fisetin被廣泛研究作為senolytic藥物，其抗氧化、抗發炎、抗癌、抗糖尿病與神經保護活性在眾多體外與體內研究中均有報告。儘管藥理潛力廣泛，fisetin的水溶性極差，嚴重限制其口服生體可用率。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Once absorbed, fisetin is extensively conjugated by UDP-glucuronosyltransferases (UGTs) and sulfotransferases in the intestinal epithelium and liver, producing fisetin glucuronide and fisetin sulfate metabolites that circulate in the plasma. Because these conjugates have reduced biological activity and are rapidly excreted via bile and urine, the parent aglycone fisetin reaches only low concentrations in tissues. The extent of this phase II metabolism is a primary cause of fisetin's poor oral bioavailability and short plasma half-life, and it is one reason most preclinical efficacy studies have used intraperitoneal injection rather than oral dosing.
context.zh-TW: 一旦被吸收，fisetin會被腸道上皮與肝臟中的UDP-葡萄糖醛酸轉移酶（UGT）與磺基轉移酶廣泛接合，產生在血漿中循環的fisetin葡萄糖醛酸與fisetin硫酸代謝物。由於這些接合物生物活性降低，且會經由膽汁與尿液迅速排泄，母體苷元fisetin在組織中僅達到低濃度。此第二相反應的程度是fisetin口服生體可用率差與血漿半衰期短的主要原因，也是多數臨床前療效研究採用腹腔注射而非口服給藥的原因之一。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin regulates the PI3K/Akt pathway, which is central to both its anti-cancer and senolytic activities. In cancer cells, fisetin suppresses Akt phosphorylation and downstream mTOR signaling, reducing proliferation and survival, whereas in the context of senescence, fisetin's inhibition of PI3K/Akt removes a survival signal that senescent cells rely on, triggering their elimination. Fisetin's modulation of this pathway is dose-dependent and context-dependent, and it also crosstalks with MAPK/ERK signaling. Nanoformulations designed to raise fisetin exposure are expected to amplify these pathway-level effects by delivering higher intracellular concentrations.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin調節PI3K/Akt途徑，此途徑對其抗癌與senolytic活性均屬核心。在癌細胞中，fisetin抑制Akt磷酸化及下游mTOR訊號，減少增殖與存活；而在衰老的情境中，fisetin對PI3K/Akt的抑制移除了衰老細胞賴以存活的存活訊號，觸發其清除。Fisetin對此途徑的調節具有劑量依賴性與情境依賴性，並與MAPK/ERK訊號發生交叉對話。旨在提高fisetin暴露量的奈米配方，預期可透過遞送更高的細胞內濃度來放大這些途徑層級的效應。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin clears senescent cells from tissues, reducing the burden of cellular senescence that accumulates with aging. In naturally aged and progeroid mice, oral fisetin lowered the number of p16INK4a-positive and SA-beta-galactosidase-positive cells in adipose tissue, skin, and other organs, and improved age-related tissue pathology. By removing senescent cells, fisetin also reduces the pro-inflammatory secretory phenotype they maintain, which contributes to age-related chronic inflammation. The capacity of fisetin to reduce cellular senescence in vivo is the defining action of its senolytic pharmacology and the basis for its proposed healthspan benefits.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin清除組織中的衰老細胞，減輕隨老化累積的細胞衰老負擔。在自然老化與早衰（progeroid）小鼠中，口服fisetin降低了脂肪組織、皮膚及其他器官中p16INK4a陽性與SA-β-半乳糖苷酶陽性細胞的數量，並改善年齡相關的組織病理。透過移除衰老細胞，fisetin也減少了它們所維持的促發炎分泌表型（SASP），此表型促成年齡相關的慢性發炎。Fisetin在體內減少細胞衰老的能力是其senolytic藥理學的定義性作用，也是其健康壽命效益的提出基礎。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: FUNDC1

context.en-US: FUNDC1 (FUN14 domain containing 1) is an outer mitochondrial membrane protein that serves as a mitophagy receptor for hypoxia-induced mitophagy, interacting directly with LC3 after dephosphorylation by phosphoglycerate mutase 5. ULK1 interacts with FUNDC1 and phosphorylates it at serine 17, enhancing FUNDC1 binding to LC3, and FUNDC1 interacts with OPA1 and DRP1 in a manner regulated by serine 13 phosphorylation during hypoxia or membrane potential loss. DRP1 can interact with overexpressed FUNDC1 to facilitate mitochondrial fragmentation and Parkin-mediated mitophagy.
context.zh-TW: FUNDC1（FUN14 domain containing 1）是一種粒線體外膜蛋白，作為缺氧誘發粒線體自噬的受體，在經磷酸甘油酸變位酶5（phosphoglycerate mutase 5）去磷酸化後直接與LC3交互作用。ULK1與FUNDC1交互作用並在絲胺酸17（serine 17）處使其磷酸化，增強FUNDC1與LC3的結合；而在缺氧或膜電位喪失期間，FUNDC1與OPA1及DRP1的交互作用則受絲胺酸13磷酸化調節。DRP1可與過度表現的FUNDC1交互作用，以促進粒線體碎裂與Parkin介導的粒線體自噬。

source_document: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

context.en-US: GCN2 is an evolutionarily conserved stress-responsive serine/threonine kinase activated by amino acid restriction through uncharged tRNAs, as well as by ribosome stalling and collision. Activated GCN2 phosphorylates eIF2alpha, which suppresses global protein synthesis while selectively promoting translation of ATF4, a key transcription factor that activates stress response and autophagy genes. This selective translation of ATF4 is a central feature of the integrated stress response engaged during protein restriction. Genetic evidence confirms GCN2's importance: Drosophila lacking Gcn2 die when amino acids are restricted, deletion of Gcn2 in yeast blocks dietary restriction lifespan extension, and GCN2 overexpression extends lifespan in both organisms.
context.zh-TW: GCN2是一種演化上保守、對壓力有反應的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，由胺基酸限制透過未帶電荷的tRNA活化，也可由核醣體停滯與碰撞活化。活化的GCN2使eIF2alpha磷酸化，抑制整體蛋白質合成，同時選擇性地促進ATF4的轉譯；ATF4是活化壓力反應與自噬基因的關鍵轉錄因子。ATF4的選擇性轉譯是蛋白質限制期間所啟動的整合性壓力反應（integrated stress response）的核心特徵。遺傳證據確認了GCN2的重要性：缺乏Gcn2的果蠅在胺基酸受限時會死亡，酵母菌中刪除Gcn2會阻斷飲食限制的壽命延長，而GCN2過度表現則在兩種生物體中均延長壽命。

context.en-US: Tryptophan depletion caused by IDO1 activity activates the GCN2 stress kinase, which leads to cell cycle arrest, anergy, or apoptosis in effector T cells, since tryptophan is essential for T cell proliferation. This amino-acid starvation response is one of the two main mechanisms of IDO1-mediated immunosuppression, the other being kynurenine/aryl hydrocarbon receptor signaling that promotes regulatory T cells. Together these pathways create an immunosuppressive microenvironment exploited by tumors, and this biology is the rationale for IDO1 inhibitors in immuno-oncology: blocking tryptophan catabolism is intended to relieve GCN2-driven T cell suppression and restore antitumor immunity.
context.zh-TW: IDO1活性引起的色胺酸耗竭會活化GCN2壓力激酶，導致效應T細胞的細胞週期停滯、無反應性（anergy）或凋亡，因為色胺酸對T細胞增殖不可或缺。此胺基酸飢餓反應是IDO1介導免疫抑制的兩大主要機制之一，另一機制是促進調節性T細胞的犬尿胺酸/芳香烴受體（aryl hydrocarbon receptor）訊號。這些途徑共同形成腫瘤所利用的免疫抑制微環境，而此生物學正是免疫腫瘤學中IDO1抑制劑的學理依據：阻斷色胺酸分解代謝旨在解除GCN2驅動的T細胞抑制，並恢復抗腫瘤免疫。

context.en-US: The metabolic hormone ghrelin, a major regulator of food intake, also exerts immunomodulatory and thymopoietic effects. Ghrelin binds immune cell subsets via ghrelin-specific receptors and localizes to lipid rafts of activated T cells. Dixit et al. reported that ghrelin reduces age-associated inflammatory responses in mice, and in aged thymus both ghrelin and growth hormone levels decrease in correlation with functional thymic involution and elevated inflammation.
context.zh-TW: 代謝激素ghrelin（飢餓素）是食物攝取的主要調節者，也具有免疫調節與胸腺生成（thymopoietic）效應。Ghrelin透過ghrelin特異性受體與免疫細胞亞群結合，並定位於活化T細胞的脂筏。Dixit等人報告ghrelin可減少小鼠中年齡相關的發炎反應，而在老年胸腺中，ghrelin與生長激素水平均下降，與功能性胸腺退化及發炎升高相關。

context.en-US: Ghrelin reduces age-associated inflammatory responses in mice. In the aged thymus, ghrelin and growth hormone levels decrease and correlate with functional thymic involution and generalized elevated inflammation, implying that the decline of these hormones contributes to the age-associated inflammatory milieu. In addition to suppressing inflammation, ghrelin has a stimulatory effect on thymus cellularity, increasing early thymic progenitors and recent thymic emigrants.
context.zh-TW: Ghrelin減少小鼠中年齡相關的發炎反應。在老年胸腺中，ghrelin與生長激素水平下降，並與功能性胸腺退化及全面性發炎升高相關，顯示這些激素的衰退促成了年齡相關的發炎環境。除了抑制發炎外，ghrelin對胸腺細胞數量具有刺激作用，可增加早期胸腺前驅細胞與近期胸腺遷出細胞（recent thymic emigrants）。

subject: Glutathione

context.en-US: Glutathione, an antioxidant, keeps lipid peroxides at steady levels and thereby staves off ferroptosis in healthy cells. Ferroptosis is an iron-dependent cell death pathway in which the accumulation of lipid peroxides becomes toxic, and glutathione's antioxidant capacity is the canonical defense against this form of death. The Salk study's discovery is notable because the acid ceramidase axis sensitizes cells to ferroptosis without involving changes in glutathione levels, operating instead through lipid metabolism - an entirely novel, GPX4/GSH-independent pathway. This contrasts with the classical view that ferroptosis sensitivity is controlled chiefly by glutathione/GPX4-dependent peroxide neutralization.
context.zh-TW: 抗氧化劑麩胱甘肽將脂質過氧化物維持在穩定水平，從而保護健康細胞免受ferroptosis侵害。Ferroptosis是一種依賴鐵的細胞死亡途徑，其中脂質過氧化物的累積會產生毒性，而麩胱甘肽的抗氧化能力是對抗此種死亡形式的典型防禦。Salk研究的發現值得注意，因為酸性神經醯胺酶軸在不涉及麩胱甘肽水平變化的情況下使細胞對ferroptosis敏感化，而是透過脂質代謝運作——這是一條全新的、GPX4/GSH非依賴性途徑。這與「ferroptosis敏感性主要由麩胱甘肽/GPX4依賴性過氧化物中和所控制」的經典觀點形成對比。

source_document: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md

subject: Glycation

context.en-US: Glycation is the product of the reaction between a sugar and the free amino group of proteins, referred to as cross-linking, and the accumulation of these glycation byproducts results in large, cross-linked molecules that inhibit the ability of the cell to function normally. Advanced glycation end products (AGEs) accumulate with age in tissues, contributing to arterial stiffening and cardiac enlargement. Levels of cross-linking products in diabetics are two to three times those of non-diabetics, and AGEs are believed to play an important role in the development of diabetic complications.
context.zh-TW: 糖化（glycation）是糖與蛋白質游離胺基之間反應的產物，又稱交叉連結（cross-linking），而這些糖化副產物的累積會形成大型、交叉連結的分子，抑制細胞正常運作的能力。晚期糖化終產物（AGEs）隨年齡在組織中累積，促成動脈硬化與心臟肥大。糖尿病患者的交叉連結產物水平是非糖尿病患者的兩到三倍，且AGEs被認為在糖尿病併發症的發展中扮演重要角色。

context.en-US: HAF-1 is an inner mitochondrial membrane ABC-transporter family protein in C. elegans that exports matrix-derived peptides into the cytosol to signal mitochondrial stress. Proteins degraded by matrix proteases generate peptides that exit the mitochondria through HAF-1 (analogous to the yeast Mdl1 transporter), and this peptide release triggers a nuclear transcriptional response involving the ubiquitin-like protein UBL-5, the homeobox transcription factor DVE-1, and ATFS-1. The mechanism is reminiscent of peptide-based quorum sensing in gram-positive bacteria, where peptides exported via ABC transporters activate two-component histidine kinase sensors.
context.zh-TW: HAF-1 是線蟲（C. elegans）粒線體內膜上的 ABC 轉運蛋白家族蛋白，負責將基質來源的胜肽輸出至細胞質，以傳遞粒線體壓力訊號。經基質蛋白酶降解的蛋白質會產生胜肽，透過 HAF-1 離開粒線體（類似酵母菌的 Mdl1 轉運蛋白），此胜肽釋放會觸發涉及類泛素蛋白 UBL-5、同源框轉錄因子 DVE-1 及 ATFS-1 的核轉錄反應。此機制令人聯想到革蘭氏陽性菌中基於胜肽的群體感應，細菌透過 ABC 轉運蛋白輸出的胜肽會活化雙組分組織胺酸激酶感測器。

context.en-US: HRV is highly individual and a universal normal range does not exist; factors such as age, sex, health conditions, and activity levels all shape an individual's baseline. General adult ranges only serve as rough guidelines, and HRV declines with age. More important than any single raw number is an individual's personal baseline trend: a sustained drop of 20 percent or more in average HRV is a far more insightful signal than a specific value on a standardized chart, making trends over 3 to 7 days the practical unit of analysis.
context.zh-TW: HRV 高度因人而異，並不存在通用的正常範圍；年齡、性別、健康狀況與活動量等因素都會塑造個人的基線。一般成人的參考區間僅供粗略參考，且 HRV 會隨年齡增長而下降。比任何單一數值更重要的是個人基線趨勢：平均 HRV 持續下降 20% 以上，遠比標準圖表上的特定數值更具洞察力，因此 3 至 7 天的趨勢才是實際的分析單位。

context.en-US: HRV is directly controlled by the autonomic nervous system, which has two main branches with opposing effects. The sympathetic nervous system, the fight-flight-freeze system, releases adrenaline and cortisol that force the heart to beat faster and more rhythmically, lowering HRV. The parasympathetic nervous system, the rest-digest-and-repair system controlled heavily by the vagus nerve, allows more fluctuation between heartbeats, raising HRV. A high HRV therefore reflects strong vagal tone and a cardiovascular system that is highly responsive and flexible, while low HRV signals chronic stress, fatigue, or illness.
context.zh-TW: HRV 直接受自律神經系統控制，該系統有兩大作用相反的支系。交感神經系統（戰逃僵系統）會釋放腎上腺素與皮質醇，迫使心臟跳得更快且更規律，進而降低 HRV。副交感神經系統（休息消化修復系統）主要由迷走神經控制，允許心跳之間有較大的波動，進而提高 HRV。因此，高 HRV 反映強大的迷走神經張力，以及高度敏銳且具彈性的心血管系統；而低 HRV 則代表慢性壓力、疲勞或疾病。

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol enhances the phosphorylation and activity of Akt, a central pro-survival kinase. In senescence-accelerated mice, oral honokiol (1 mg/kg) prevented age-related memory and learning deficits by preserving cholinergic neurons and enhancing Akt phosphorylation, part of the pro-survival PI3K/Akt pathway. Akt activation contributes to honokiol's neuroprotective effects against ischemia, beta-amyloid toxicity, and other insults, complementing its GABA-A modulation, Na+/K+-ATPase preservation, and anti-inflammatory actions.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚會增強 Akt（核心促存活激酶）的磷酸化與活性。在加速衰老小鼠中，口服厚朴酚（1 mg/kg）透過保存膽鹼性神經元並增強 Akt 磷酸化，預防了與年齡相關的記憶與學習缺陷，此屬促存活 PI3K/Akt 路徑的一部分。Akt 活化有助於厚朴酚對缺血、β-類澱粉毒性及其他傷害的神經保護作用，並與其 GABA-A 調節、Na+/K+-ATPase 保存及抗發炎作用相輔相成。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol attenuates inflammatory pain, reducing formalin-induced paw-licking behavior in the inflammatory phase and thermal hyperalgesia in mice. It blocks nociceptive signaling evoked by NMDA, glutamate, substance P, and prostaglandin E2 (PGE2), and decreases formalin-induced c-Fos protein expression in superficial laminae (I-II) of the L4-L5 lumbar dorsal horn. Compared with magnolol, honokiol is more selective for NMDA-induced behavioral responses and hyperalgesia. Its analgesic effects are multifactorial, involving both the inflammatory cascade and glutamatergic/NMDA receptor pathways.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚可減輕發炎性疼痛，降低福馬林誘發之發炎期的舔足行為及小鼠的熱痛覺過敏。它能阻斷由 NMDA、麩胺酸、P 物質及前列腺素 E2（PGE2）引發的傷害性訊號傳遞，並降低福馬林誘發的 c-Fos 蛋白在 L4-L5 腰薦背角淺層（I-II 層）的表現。與和厚朴酚相比，厚朴酚對 NMDA 誘發的行為反應與痛覺過敏更具選擇性。其鎮痛作用是多重因素共同造成的，同時涉及發炎級聯反應及麩胺酸能/NMDA 受體路徑。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: While honokiol is neuroprotective at low doses, it increases neuronal death in vitro at higher concentrations: 100 uM applied directly to fetal cortical neurons is toxic. This dose-dependent biphasic behavior underscores the need to define human pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic parameters before clinical administration. The potential neurotoxicity at supraphysiological concentrations, combined with honokiol's antithrombotic activity, highlights the importance of careful dosing and patient selection for any therapeutic use.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚在低劑量下具有神經保護作用，但在較高濃度下會增加體外神經元死亡：100 uM 直接施加於胎兒皮質神經元即具毒性。這種劑量依賴的雙相行為凸顯了在臨床投藥前須先確立人體藥動學與藥效學參數。超生理濃度下的潛在神經毒性，加上厚朴酚的抗血栓活性，強調了任何治療用途都需謹慎給藥並審慎選擇病患。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol, a lipid-soluble lignan extracted from Magnolia species, readily crosses the blood-brain barrier to exert its effects in the central nervous system, including anti-tumorigenic and neuroprotective actions. Its lipid solubility allows it to pass lipid bilayers and act at multiple intracellular and membrane sites, a property shared with the structurally related anesthetic propofol and the analog magnolol. BBB penetration is a prerequisite for honokiol's anxiolytic, analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-seizure activities in the brain.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚是從木蘭屬（Magnolia）植物中提取的脂溶性木脂素，能輕易穿越血腦屏障，在中樞神經系統中發揮作用，包括抗腫瘤生成與神經保護作用。其脂溶性使其能穿過脂質雙層，作用於多個細胞內與膜上的位點，此特性與結構相關的麻醉劑丙泊酚及類似物和厚朴酚共通。穿透血腦屏障是厚朴酚在大腦中發揮抗焦慮、鎮痛、抗發炎與抗癲癇活性的先決條件。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol increases the activity of glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD), the enzyme responsible for GABA synthesis, in the cortex and hippocampus of mice. By enhancing GAD(65) and GAD(67) activity, honokiol can augment the brain's synthesis of the inhibitory neurotransmitter GABA, which may complement its direct positive allosteric modulation of GABA-A receptors. This combined effect on GABAergic tone is consistent with honokiol's central depressant, anticonvulsant, anxiolytic, and sleep-promoting pharmacological profile.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚會提高小鼠皮質與海馬迴中麩胺酸脫羧酶（GAD）的活性，此酶負責 GABA 的合成。透過增強 GAD(65) 與 GAD(67) 的活性，厚朴酚可增強大腦合成抑制性神經傳導物質 GABA，這可能與其對 GABA-A 受體的直接正向異位調節相輔相成。這種對 GABA 能張力的綜合作用，與厚朴酚中樞抑制、抗驚厥、抗焦慮及促睡眠的藥理特性一致。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol is a potent inhibitor of arterial thrombosis, acting through endothelial cell protection and stimulation of prostacyclin production. This antithrombotic effect is a safety consideration: caution is advised in coagulopathic patients, those with hemorrhagic stroke or hemorrhagic transformation after ischemic stroke, patients on warfarin or low-molecular-weight heparin, and individuals with clotting disorders such as hemophilia or von Willebrand's deficiency. The bleeding risk must be weighed against honokiol's neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory benefits before clinical use.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚是動脈血栓的強效抑制劑，其作用機制為保護內皮細胞並刺激前列環素生成。此抗血栓作用是安全考量點：凝血功能異常病患、出血性中風或缺血性中風後出血性轉化的病患、服用華法林或低分子量肝素的病患，以及患有血友病或 von Willebrand 因子缺乏等凝血疾病者，均應謹慎使用。臨床使用前必須權衡出血風險與厚朴酚的神經保護及抗發炎效益。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol inhibits caspase-3 activity as part of its protection against beta-amyloid-induced neuronal death. In PC12 neuronal cultures challenged with Abeta, honokiol's neuroprotection was associated with decreased reactive oxygen species production, suppressed intracellular calcium elevation, and inhibition of the executioner caspase-3, thereby limiting apoptotic cell death. This anti-apoptotic action complements honokiol's mitochondrial preservation and pro-survival Akt signaling, contributing to its broad neuroprotective profile against amyloid toxicity and other neurodegenerative insults.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚抑制 caspase-3 活性，是其對抗 β-類澱粉誘發之神經元死亡的保護作用之一。在以 Aβ 刺激的 PC12 神經元培養中，厚朴酚的神經保護作用與活性氧物質產生減少、細胞內鈣離子升高受抑制，以及執行型 caspase-3 受抑制相關，因而限制細胞凋亡性死亡。此抗凋亡作用與厚朴酚的粒線體保存及促存活 Akt 訊息傳導相輔相成，共同構成其對類澱粉毒性及其他神經退化性傷害的廣泛神經保護特性。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol inhibits cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) expression, contributing to its anti-inflammatory activity. In RAW264.7 macrophage-like cells stimulated with Porphyromonas gingivalis fimbriae, honokiol reduced COX-2 expression alongside inhibition of NF-kappaB activation, and it is generally more potent in this regard than the structurally related eugenol and bis-eugenol. By limiting COX-2-driven prostanoid production, honokiol dampens inflammation and inflammatory pain signaling, complementing its inhibition of TNF-alpha, nitric oxide, and NF-kappaB.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚抑制環氧合酶-2（COX-2）的表現，構成其抗發炎活性的一部分。在以牙齦紫單胞菌（Porphyromonas gingivalis）菌毛刺激的 RAW264.7 巨噬細胞樣細胞中，厚朴酚在抑制 NF-kappaB 活化的同時降低了 COX-2 表現，且在這方面通常比結構相關的丁香酚與雙丁香酚更有效。藉由限制 COX-2 驅動的前列腺素類產生，厚朴酚能抑制發炎與發炎性疼痛訊號，並與其對 TNF-alpha、一氧化氮及 NF-kappaB 的抑制作用相輔相成。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol inhibits neutrophil infiltration and reactive oxygen species production after cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury, as measured by luminol-amplified chemiluminescence in neutrophils. By reducing the accumulation and oxidative burst of neutrophils at the site of ischemic injury, honokiol limits secondary tissue damage following stroke. This anti-inflammatory action is complemented by inhibition of glial NF-kappaB activation and cytokine production, together contributing to honokiol's ability to reduce infarct volume in focal cerebral ischemia-reperfusion models.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚抑制腦缺血再灌注損傷後的中性球浸潤與活性氧物質產生（以嗜中性球的魯米諾增強化學發光測定）。透過減少缺血損傷部位中性球的累積與氧化爆發，厚朴酚限制了中風後的繼發性組織損傷。此抗發炎作用與膠質細胞 NF-kappaB 活化及細胞激素產生的抑制相輔相成，共同促成厚朴酚在局部腦缺血再灌注模型中縮小梗塞體積的能力。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol suppresses NF-kappaB activation in multiple cell types, a key node in its anti-inflammatory activity. In LPS-stimulated macrophages honokiol inhibited NF-kappaB activation along with PKC-alpha membrane translocation and MAPK signaling, reducing TNF-alpha and nitric oxide production. It likewise suppressed glial NF-kappaB activation and cytokine production during cerebral ischemia-reperfusion and inhibited COX-2 expression in RAW264.7 macrophage-like cells. These convergent actions on the NF-kappaB pathway underlie honokiol's neuroprotective and analgesic anti-inflammatory effects.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚在多種細胞類型中抑制 NF-kappaB 活化，此為其抗發炎活性的關鍵節點。在 LPS 刺激的巨噬細胞中，厚朴酚抑制 NF-kappaB 活化，同時抑制 PKC-alpha 膜轉位與 MAPK 訊息傳導，降低 TNF-alpha 及一氧化氮的產生。它在腦缺血再灌注期間同樣抑制膠質細胞 NF-kappaB 活化與細胞激素產生，並在 RAW264.7 巨噬細胞樣細胞中抑制 COX-2 表現。這些對 NF-kappaB 路徑的收斂性作用，構成了厚朴酚神經保護與鎮痛抗發炎效果的基礎。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol inhibits NMDA-evoked cationic influx, blocking excessive calcium entry that would otherwise drive excitotoxic neuronal injury and seizures. In rat cerebellar granule cells, honokiol inhibited repetitive firing by blocking glutamate-, NMDA-, and K+-evoked cation influx, and intraperitoneal honokiol (1 and 5 mg/kg) increased seizure thresholds in NMDA-infusion models, being more potent than magnolol. In ischemic conditions honokiol also disrupts PSD95-nNOS coupling at the NMDA receptor postsynaptic complex, preventing neurotoxic nitric oxide production downstream of NMDA receptor activation.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚抑制 NMDA 誘發的陽離子內流，阻斷過量的鈣離子進入，否則這些鈣離子會驅動興奮毒性神經元損傷與癲癇發作。在大鼠小腦顆粒細胞中，厚朴酚透過阻斷麩胺酸、NMDA 及 K+ 誘發的陽離子內流來抑制重複放電，且腹腔注射厚朴酚（1 及 5 mg/kg）可提高 NMDA 輸注模型中的癲癇閾值，效力優於和厚朴酚。在缺血條件下，厚朴酚還會破壞 NMDA 受體突觸後複合物處的 PSD95-nNOS 耦聯，防止 NMDA 受體活化下游之神經毒性一氧化氮產生。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: In animal behavioral models, honokiol produces anxiolysis at doses as low as 0.2 mg/kg with fewer motor and cognitive side effects than the benzodiazepine diazepam. The anxiolytic effect of honokiol is blocked by flumazenil, bicuculline, CCK-4, and caffeine, whereas these agents differentially affect diazepam's anxiolysis (e.g., caffeine enhances diazepam's effect), suggesting honokiol may act through partly alternative pathways in addition to GABA-A potentiation. This favorable side-effect profile is a key rationale for developing honokiol as an anxiolytic.
context.zh-TW: 在動物行為模型中，厚朴酚在低至 0.2 mg/kg 的劑量下即產生抗焦慮作用，且運動與認知副作用少於苯二氮平類藥物地西泮。厚朴酚的抗焦慮作用可被氟馬西尼、荷包牡丹鹼、CCK-4 及咖啡因阻斷，而這些藥劑對地西泮抗焦慮作用的影響則各不相同（例如咖啡因會增強地西泮的效果），顯示厚朴酚除了 GABA-A 強化之外，可能部分經由替代路徑發揮作用。這種良好的副作用特性是開發厚朴酚為抗焦慮藥物的關鍵理由。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol is a neuroprotective agent acting through a wide range of parallel mechanisms: preservation of Na+/K+-ATPase activity, phosphorylation of pro-survival factors such as Akt, preservation of mitochondrial function, positive allosteric modulation of GABA-A receptors, and suppression of glucose intolerance, reactive oxygen species, and inflammatory damage. Preclinically it mitigates the effects of stroke and seizures and improves learning and memory in behavioral models. Its therapeutic potential spans anxiety, pain, cerebrovascular injury, epilepsy, and cognitive disorders including Alzheimer's disease.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚是透過多種平行機制發揮作用的神經保護劑：保存 Na+/K+-ATPase 活性、磷酸化 Akt 等促存活因子、維持粒線體功能、正向異位調節 GABA-A 受體，以及抑制葡萄糖不耐受、活性氧物質與發炎損傷。臨床前研究顯示它能減輕中風與癲癇的影響，並改善行為模型中的學習與記憶。其治療潛力涵蓋焦慮、疼痛、腦血管損傷、癲癇及包括阿茲海默症在內的認知障礙。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol is a positive allosteric modulator of both synaptic and extrasynaptic GABA-A receptors, a known target of benzodiazepines and other anxiolytics. It shows markedly higher efficacy at receptors containing the delta subunit (900-1100% response) compared with alpha-beta-gamma-only receptors (300-500%), and it allosterically increases the affinity of low-affinity sites, increasing [3H]muscimol binding about three-fold. This GABA-A modulation underpins honokiol's anxiolytic, hypnotic, and anticonvulsant properties and is the basis of its sleep-promoting effects via the benzodiazepine site.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚是突觸型與突觸外 GABA-A 受體（苯二氮平類及其他抗焦慮藥物的已知靶點）的正向異位調節劑。在含 delta 亞基的受體上，其效力明顯更高（反應為 900-1100%），相較於僅含 alpha-beta-gamma 的受體（300-500%）；它並以異位方式提高低親和力位點的親和力，使 [3H]muscimol 結合增加約三倍。這種 GABA-A 調節構成了厚朴酚抗焦慮、催眠與抗驚厥特性的基礎，也是其經由苯二氮平作用位點產生促睡眠效果的機制。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol preserves mitochondrial function as part of its neuroprotective mechanism. In preclinical ischemia models, honokiol maintained enzymatic mitochondrial function alongside Na+/K+-ATPase activity, and it protects neurons by preventing glucose- and ROS-mediated damage while preserving mitochondrial integrity. Honokiol also reduces beta-amyloid-induced neuronal death through decreased ROS production, suppressed intracellular calcium elevation, and inhibition of caspase-3 activity. These effects collectively position mitochondrial preservation and reduced oxidative stress as core components of honokiol's cytoprotective profile.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚維持粒線體功能，此為其神經保護機制的一部分。在臨床前缺血模型中，厚朴酚在維持 Na+/K+-ATPase 活性的同時保持了粒線體的酶功能，並透過防止葡萄糖及 ROS 介導的損傷、同時維持粒線體完整性來保護神經元。厚朴酚也透過降低 ROS 產生、抑制細胞內鈣離子升高及抑制 caspase-3 活性，減少 β-類澱粉誘發的神經元死亡。這些效應共同使粒線體保存與氧化壓力降低成為厚朴酚細胞保護特性的核心組成。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol exerts neuroprotection in part by preserving the activity of the Na+/K+-ATPase, the membrane pump critical for maintaining neuronal resting potential and ion homeostasis. In mouse models of cerebral ischemia, honokiol treatment preserved Na+/K+-ATPase activity and enzymatic mitochondrial function, correlating with reduced neuronal damage. Together with phosphorylation of pro-survival factors, preservation of mitochondrial function, and GABA-A modulation, Na+/K+-ATPase preservation is one of at least five distinct parallel mechanisms through which honokiol protects neurons from ischemic and oxidative injury.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚的神經保護作用部分來自於保存 Na+/K+-ATPase 的活性，此膜幫浦對維持神經元靜止膜電位與離子恆定至關重要。在腦缺血小鼠模型中，厚朴酚治療保存了 Na+/K+-ATPase 活性與粒線體酶功能，並與神經元損傷減輕相關。加上促存活因子的磷酸化、粒線體功能的維持及 GABA-A 調節，Na+/K+-ATPase 保存是厚朴酚保護神經元免於缺血與氧化損傷的至少五種不同平行機制之一。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol promotes non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep and shortens sleep latency. In mouse studies, honokiol at 10 and 20 mg/kg significantly decreased sleep latency and increased the amount of NREM sleep without affecting REM sleep or EEG power density, and it excited sleep-promoting neurons in the ventrolateral preoptic area. These effects occur through the benzodiazepine site of the GABA-A receptor. The combined sleep-promoting and anxiolytic actions suggest a potential role for honokiol as an anesthetic adjunct.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚可促進非快速動眼（NREM）睡眠並縮短入睡潛伏期。在小鼠研究中，厚朴酚在 10 及 20 mg/kg 劑量下顯著縮短入睡潛伏期並增加 NREM 睡眠量，但不影響 REM 睡眠或 EEG 功率密度，且會興奮腹外側視前區的促睡眠神經元。這些效應經由 GABA-A 受體的苯二氮平位點產生。促睡眠與抗焦慮作用的結合，顯示厚朴酚可能作為麻醉輔助劑的潛力。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol significantly decreased beta-amyloid (Abeta)-induced neuronal death in neuronal culture models of Alzheimer's disease. In screening nine compounds from Chinese herbs for anti-Alzheimer's activity, only honokiol and magnolol markedly reduced Abeta-induced cell death. The protective mechanism involves decreased ROS production, suppressed intracellular calcium elevation, and inhibition of caspase-3 activity. A honokiol-containing extract of Magnolia officinalis also prevented lipopolysaccharide-induced memory deficiency via antineuroinflammatory and antiamyloidogenic effects, supporting honokiol's therapeutic potential in Alzheimer's disease.
context.zh-TW: 在阿茲海默症的神經元培養模型中，厚朴酚顯著降低 β-類澱粉（Aβ）誘發的神經元死亡。在篩選九種中草藥化合物的抗阿茲海默活性時，僅厚朴酚與和厚朴酚能顯著減少 Aβ 誘發的細胞死亡。其保護機制涉及 ROS 產生減少、細胞內鈣離子升高受抑制及 caspase-3 活性受抑制。含厚朴酚的厚朴（Magnolia officinalis）萃取物也能透過抗神經發炎與抗類澱粉生成作用預防脂多醣誘發的記憶缺損，支持厚朴酚在阿茲海默症中的治療潛力。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol protects the brain against ischemia-reperfusion injury. Intravenous honokiol given 15 minutes before or 60 minutes after middle cerebral artery occlusion dose-dependently reduced infarct volume by 20-70% without significant hemodynamic changes. Protective mechanisms include inhibition of neutrophil infiltration and ROS production, suppression of post-ischemic glucose intolerance, disruption of the PSD95-nNOS interaction at the NMDA receptor complex (preventing calcium-dependent neurotoxic nitric oxide production), and suppression of glial NF-kappaB activation and cytokine production.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚可保護大腦免受缺血再灌注損傷。在大腦中動脈阻塞前 15 分鐘或阻塞後 60 分鐘靜脈給予厚朴酚，可依劑量將梗塞體積減少 20-70%，且無顯著的血流動力學變化。保護機制包括抑制中性球浸潤與 ROS 產生、抑制缺血後葡萄糖不耐受、破壞 NMDA 受體複合物處的 PSD95-nNOS 交互作用（防止鈣依賴的神經毒性一氧化氮產生），以及抑制膠質細胞 NF-kappaB 活化與細胞激素產生。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol reduces cerebral infarction in rodent stroke models, including both pre-ischemic and post-ischemic administration paradigms. In MCA occlusion models, intravenous honokiol significantly reduced total infarct volume without creating significant hemodynamic changes. The neuroprotection is multifactorial, involving inhibition of neutrophil infiltration and reactive oxygen species production, suppression of post-ischemic glucose intolerance, disruption of PSD95-nNOS coupling to prevent neurotoxic nitric oxide generation, and inhibition of glial NF-kappaB activation and inflammatory cytokine production during ischemia-reperfusion.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚可減少囓齒類中風模型中的腦梗塞，涵蓋缺血前與缺血後兩種投藥模式。在大腦中動脈阻塞模型中，靜脈給予厚朴酚顯著減少總梗塞體積，且不造成顯著的血流動力學變化。其神經保護作用是多因素的，涉及抑制中性球浸潤與活性氧物質產生、抑制缺血後葡萄糖不耐受、破壞 PSD95-nNOS 耦聯以防止神經毒性一氧化氮生成，以及在缺血再灌注期間抑制膠質細胞 NF-kappaB 活化與發炎性細胞激素產生。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol and its structural analog magnolol have been evaluated as potential therapies for epilepsy and related seizure disorders. Intraperitoneal injections of honokiol or magnolol (1 and 5 mg/kg) increased seizure threshold in mice challenged with intravenous NMDA, with honokiol appearing more potent than magnolol. Honokiol also ameliorated the behavioral and neurotoxic impairments induced by NMDA injection into the cerebral ventricular system, showing augmented neuroprotection compared with tea polyphenol or memantine alone, supporting a role for honokiol in seizure prevention.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚及其結構類似物和厚朴酚已被評估為癲癇及相關發作疾病的潛在療法。腹腔注射厚朴酚或和厚朴酚（1 及 5 mg/kg）可提高靜脈注射 NMDA 挑戰小鼠的癲癇閾值，且厚朴酚的效力似乎優於和厚朴酚。厚朴酚也改善了腦室系統注射 NMDA 所誘發的行為與神經毒性損害，相較於單獨使用茶多酚或美金剛展現出增強的保護作用，支持厚朴酚在預防癲癇發作中的角色。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol decreases formalin-induced c-Fos protein expression in the superficial (I-II) laminae of the L4-L5 lumbar dorsal horn in mice, a marker of spinal nociceptive neuron activation. Along with reducing formalin-induced paw-licking, this shows honokiol acts at the spinal level to dampen pain transmission during the inflammatory phase of the formalin model. Honokiol's ability to suppress dorsal-horn c-Fos parallels its blockade of NMDA-, glutamate-, substance P-, and PGE2-evoked nociception, supporting a spinal component to its analgesic activity.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚降低小鼠福馬林誘發之 L4-L5 腰薦背角淺層（I-II 層）的 c-Fos 蛋白表現，此為脊髓傷害性神經元活化的標記。加上減少福馬林誘發的舔足行為，顯示厚朴酚在脊髓層次發揮作用，於福馬林模型的發炎期減弱疼痛傳遞。厚朴酚抑制背角 c-Fos 的能力，與其阻斷 NMDA、麩胺酸、P 物質及 PGE2 誘發之傷害感受的作用並行，支持其鎮痛活性中的脊髓組成。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol inhibits nitric oxide expression in LPS-stimulated macrophages, a key anti-inflammatory effect. Nitric oxide overproduction during inflammation drives vasodilation, tissue damage, and pain; honokiol suppresses its induction by blocking PKC-alpha membrane translocation, MAPK signaling, and NF-kappaB activation. In the setting of cerebral ischemia, honokiol additionally prevents neurotoxic nitric oxide production by disrupting the PSD95-nNOS coupling at the NMDA receptor complex, thereby limiting calcium-dependent nNOS activation and downstream nitrosative neuronal injury.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚抑制 LPS 刺激巨噬細胞中的一氧化氮表現，此為關鍵的抗發炎效應。發炎期間一氧化氮過量產生會驅動血管擴張、組織損傷與疼痛；厚朴酚透過阻斷 PKC-alpha 膜轉位、MAPK 訊息傳導及 NF-kappaB 活化來抑制其誘導。在腦缺血的情境下，厚朴酚另外透過破壞 NMDA 受體複合物處的 PSD95-nNOS 耦聯來防止神經毒性一氧化氮產生，從而限制鈣依賴的 nNOS 活化及下游的硝化性神經元損傷。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

subject: Honokiol

context.en-US: Honokiol reduces TNF-alpha secretion from LPS-stimulated mouse macrophages. Using lipopolysaccharide to induce inflammation, honokiol decreased tumor necrosis factor-alpha secretion, inhibited nitric oxide expression, blocked protein kinase C-alpha membrane translocation, and suppressed NF-kappaB activation in macrophages, with similar anti-inflammatory effects translated to human monocyte-derived dendritic cells. By dampening this central pro-inflammatory cytokine, honokiol mitigates the inflammatory cascade that drives neuroinflammation and inflammatory pain, making it a candidate adjunct for inflammatory conditions.
context.zh-TW: 厚朴酚減少 LPS 刺激小鼠巨噬細胞分泌 TNF-alpha。使用脂多醣誘導發炎時，厚朴酚降低了腫瘤壞死因子-alpha 的分泌、抑制一氧化氮表現、阻斷蛋白激酶 C-alpha 膜轉位，並抑制巨噬細胞中的 NF-kappaB 活化，類似的抗發炎效果也延伸至人類單核球來源的樹突狀細胞。藉由抑制此核心促發炎細胞激素，厚朴酚緩解了驅動神經發炎與發炎性疼痛的發炎級聯反應，使其成為發炎性疾病的候選輔助用藥。

source_document: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

context.en-US: Atypical dose-response curves where a drug's effect does not follow a monotonic shape are referred to as hormetic or biphasic. This computational study shows that all hormetic networks share a similar core structure: an incoherent bivalent network motif centered on the target of the drug, in which the two interactions emanating from the target have net opposite (direct or indirect) effects over the downstream output. Around 18% of all three-node network topologies contain this motif, and topologies with an incoherent bivalent motif show a roughly five-fold increased probability of exhibiting hormesis compared with all topologies.
context.zh-TW: 藥物效應不呈單調形狀的非典型劑量反應曲線稱為荷爾米希（hormetic）或雙相反應。這項計算研究顯示，所有荷爾米希網路共享相似的核心結構：以藥物靶點為中心的不一致雙價網路模體（incoherent bivalent network motif），其中由靶點發出的兩條交互作用對下游輸出具有淨相反（直接或間接）的效應。約 18% 的三節點網路拓撲含有此模體，而含有不一致雙價模體的拓撲展現荷爾米希反應的機率約為所有拓撲的五倍。

context.en-US: The probability of a network topology producing a hormetic (non-monotonic) dose-response curve increases with network complexity: the highest number of hormetic topologies contain six or seven links, and normalized by topology count the probability of exhibiting hormesis increases as the number of active links increases, indicating that hormesis depends on network density and complexity. More than 500 of the 5346 possible three-node topologies tested show clear non-monotonic dose-response curves, and hormesis is favored in networks with a high number of repressing interactions on average.
context.zh-TW: 網路拓撲產生荷爾米希（非單調）劑量反應曲線的機率隨網路複雜度增加而上升：荷爾米希拓撲數量最多者含六或七條連結，且依拓撲數量標準化後，荷爾米希反應的機率隨活性連結數量增加而上升，顯示荷爾米希取決於網路密度與複雜度。在測試的 5346 種三節點拓撲中，超過 500 種展現明確的非單調劑量反應曲線，且荷爾米希在平均抑制性交互作用數量較高的網路中更易出現。

context.en-US: This study demonstrates that drug hormesis can be explained and predicted from network structure and should not be a cause for automatic rejection in the drug development pipeline. The two core ingredients are an incoherent bivalent network motif centered on the target of inhibition and an upstream (backward) interaction operating in the saturated enzymatic regime. Atypical dose-response curves are common among widely used drugs, including aspirin, heparin, progesterone, nicotinamide, metformin and curcumin, and understanding how the complex behavior arises allows definition of an optimal dose or strategy to benefit from the nonlinearity rather than discarding the drug.
context.zh-TW: 本研究證明藥物荷爾米希可從網路結構加以解釋與預測，不應成為藥物開發流程中自動淘汰的理由。兩個核心要素是以抑制靶點為中心的不一致雙價網路模體，以及在飽和酶學區間運作的上游（反向）交互作用。非典型劑量反應曲線在廣泛使用的藥物中相當常見，包括阿斯匹靈、肝素、黃體素、菸鹼醯胺、二甲雙胍及薑黃素；了解這種複雜行為的產生方式，可讓我們定義最佳劑量或策略以善用此非線性特性，而非放棄該藥物。

context.en-US: The study screened 5346 possible three-node network topologies of a coarse-grained signaling cascade model using a high-throughput computational approach, with 5000 parameter sets and 30 inhibitor concentrations per topology. More than 500 topologies show clear non-monotonic dose-response curves, and hormesis is favored in networks with a high number of repressing interactions on average, with the highest fraction of hormetic parameter sets in a topology composed of four repressing interactions. The probability of hormesis increases as the network becomes more complex, indicating it depends on the density and complexity of the network.
context.zh-TW: 該研究以高通量計算方法篩檢了粗略顆粒化訊息傳導級聯模型的 5346 種可能三節點網路拓撲，每種拓撲使用 5000 組參數與 30 種抑制劑濃度。超過 500 種拓撲展現明確的非單調劑量反應曲線，且荷爾米希在平均抑制性交互作用數量較高的網路中更受青睞，其中由四條抑制性交互作用組成的拓撲擁有最高比例的荷爾米希參數組。荷爾米希的機率隨網路複雜度增加而上升，顯示其取決於網路的密度與複雜度。

context.en-US: HSPA8 activates NF-κB signaling by destabilizing IκBβ protein in the absence of lipopolysaccharide or by facilitating its nuclear translocation in the presence of LPS, an activity synergized by TXNDC5 to exacerbate the inflammatory phenotype of synovial fibroblasts in rheumatoid arthritis. In senescent cells, apigenin and the HSPA8 inhibitor VER155008 reverse the cytoplasmic degradation of IκBα and the cytoplasm-to-nucleus translocation of NF-κB subunits p65 and p50, indicating a shared mechanism in curtailing NF-κB complex activation. HSPA8 is also essential for VEGF-induced Akt phosphorylation.
context.zh-TW: HSPA8 在缺乏脂多醣時透過使 IκBβ 蛋白不穩定，或在存在 LPS 時促進其核轉位來活化 NF-κB 訊息傳導，此活性經 TXNDC5 協同作用，加劇類風濕性關節炎滑膜纖維母細胞的發炎表現型。在衰老細胞中，芹菜素與 HSPA8 抑制劑 VER155008 可逆轉 IκBα 的細胞質降解，以及 NF-κB 次單元 p65 與 p50 由細胞質向細胞核的轉位，顯示在抑制 NF-κB 複合物活化上具有共通機制。HSPA8 對 VEGF 誘導的 Akt 磷酸化亦不可或缺。

context.en-US: HSPA8 (HSC70), a member of the heat shock protein 70 family, directly binds phosphorylated ATM, as shown by p-ATM-mediated co-immunoprecipitation, and this interaction is specifically attenuated by apigenin treatment. ATM is the central modulator of the DNA damage response whose activation drives a persistent SASP; the HSPA8-ATM crosstalk represents an upstream transduction step in the transition from the acute stress-associated phenotype to the full SASP.
context.zh-TW: HSPA8（HSC70）是熱休克蛋白 70 家族的成員，可直接結合磷酸化的 ATM（如 p-ATM 介導的共免疫沉澱所示），而此交互作用會特異性地被芹菜素處理削弱。ATM 是 DNA 損傷反應的核心調節者，其活化會驅動持續性的 SASP；HSPA8-ATM 交互對話代表從急性壓力相關表現型轉變為完整 SASP 過程中的上游傳導步驟。

context.en-US: HSPA8 (HSC70) also directly binds p38 MAPK, a stress kinase downstream of TAK1 that, together with PI3K/Akt/mTOR engagement, supports formation of the chronic secretory phenotype (SASP). Co-immunoprecipitation confirmed that HSPA8 interacts with p38 MAPK, and this interaction is markedly weakened when senescent cells are treated with apigenin, whereas NPM1-p38 MAPK binding is unchanged. Because apigenin's target PRDX6 co-immunoprecipitates with HSPA8, the model is that apigenin restrains PRDX6 PLA2 activity, affecting HSPA8 activation and thereby abrogating its downstream interactions with both ATM and p38 MAPK, blocking multiple signaling sections that mediate SASP progression.
context.zh-TW: HSPA8（HSC70）也直接結合 p38 MAPK，此為 TAK1 下游的壓力激酶，與 PI3K/Akt/mTOR 的參與共同支持慢性分泌表現型（SASP）的形成。共免疫沉澱證實 HSPA8 與 p38 MAPK 交互作用，且當衰老細胞以芹菜素處理時此交互作用顯著減弱，而 NPM1-p38 MAPK 結合則不受影響。由於芹菜素的靶點 PRDX6 與 HSPA8 共免疫沉澱，其模型為：芹菜素抑制 PRDX6 的 PLA2 活性，影響 HSPA8 活化，進而取消其與 ATM 及 p38 MAPK 的下游交互作用，阻斷介導 SASP 進展的多個訊息傳導區段。

context.en-US: Human growth hormone (HGH) is widely used for rejuvenation and longevity, yet it actually accelerates aging and shortens lifespan. Growth hormone is a pro-aging hormone because it indirectly activates mTOR, and the hype around growth hormone is based on a single publication that misinterpreted its acute effects. Unlike HGH, the anti-aging effects of rapamycin are not based on a single paper or a wild guess but on the work of thousands of scientists studying mTOR and its inhibitors in diverse organisms from yeast to humans.
context.zh-TW: 人類生長激素（HGH）被廣泛用於回春與長壽，但它實際上會加速衰老並縮短壽命。生長激素是促衰老激素，因為它會間接活化 mTOR；而生長激素的炒作源於單一出版物誤解了其急性效應。與 HGH 不同，雷帕黴素的抗衰老效果並非基於單一論文或隨意猜測，而是基於數千名科學家從酵母菌到人類等各種生物中研究 mTOR 及其抑制劑的成果。

context.en-US: Growth hormone (GH) is a peptide hormone that impacts the immune system via its stimulatory effects on insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1). Hematopoietic cells can produce GH that indirectly promotes immune reconstitution via IGF-1 production, and IGF-1 provides anti-apoptotic signals and promotes immune cell survival. IGF-1 may also act directly on thymic stromal cells as a component of the thymus microenvironment cross-talk network and stimulate IL-7 production, and intrathymic IL-7 in turn promotes and regulates T cell survival and function.
context.zh-TW: 生長激素（GH）是一種胜肽激素，透過對胰島素樣生長因子 1（IGF-1）的刺激作用影響免疫系統。造血細胞可產生 GH，經由 IGF-1 的產生間接促進免疫重建；IGF-1 提供抗凋亡訊號並促進免疫細胞存活。IGF-1 也可能作為胸腺微環境交互對話網絡的一環，直接作用於胸腺基質細胞並刺激 IL-7 產生，而胸腺內 IL-7 反過來促進並調節 T 細胞的存活與功能。

subject: Humanin

context.en-US: FPRL1, a seven-transmembrane G-protein-coupled receptor, was the first humanin receptor to be described. Humanin acts as an agonist for FPRL1 by inducing Ca2+ mobilization and rapid activation of ERK1/2 signaling, a commonly induced downstream pathway of G-protein-coupled receptors. In neuroblasts, both the 42-aa form of beta-amyloid peptide and humanin activate FPRL1, but only Abeta42 is cytotoxic, and this cytotoxicity is reversed by humanin, suggesting that the neuroprotective effects of humanin might be accomplished by competitively binding to FPRL1, which may contribute to its cytoprotective aspects.
context.zh-TW: FPRL1 是七次跨膜 G 蛋白偶聯受體，為第一個被描述的 humanin 受體。Humanin 作為 FPRL1 的促效劑，誘導 Ca2+ 動員及 ERK1/2 訊號的快速活化，此為 G 蛋白偶聯受體常見誘發的下游路徑。在神經母細胞中，42 個胺基酸形式的 β-類澱粉胜肽與 humanin 都會活化 FPRL1，但只有 Aβ42 具細胞毒性，且此毒性可被 humanin 逆轉，顯示 humanin 的神經保護作用可能是透過競爭性結合 FPRL1 達成，這可能構成其細胞保護特性的一部分。

source_document: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

subject: Humanin

context.en-US: The second reported humanin receptor is a trimeric complex consisting of the ciliary neurotrophic factor receptor (CNTFR), the cytokine receptor WSX-1, and the transmembrane glycoprotein gp130. Hashimoto et al showed that humanin induces STAT3 activation, which was required for its neuroprotective effects. In vitro pulldown assays showed humanin coprecipitates with CNTFR and WSX-1 but not IL-6 receptor alpha, and knockdown of CNTFR or WSX-1 abolishes humanin-dependent cytoprotection against AD-related insults. Humanin also promotes hetero-oligomerization of CNTFR, WSX-1, and gp130, which relays signals through JAK/STAT and ERK1/2 pathways.
context.zh-TW: 第二個被報導的 humanin 受體是由睫狀神經營養因子受體（CNTFR）、細胞激素受體 WSX-1 及跨膜醣蛋白 gp130 組成的三聚體複合物。Hashimoto 等人證明 humanin 誘導 STAT3 活化，此為其神經保護作用所需。體外 pull-down 實驗顯示 humanin 可與 CNTFR 及 WSX-1 共沉澱，但不與 IL-6 受體 alpha 共沉澱；而敲低 CNTFR 或 WSX-1 會消除 humanin 依賴的、對抗阿茲海默相關傷害的細胞保護作用。Humanin 也促進 CNTFR、WSX-1 與 gp130 的異源寡聚化，此複合物經由 JAK/STAT 及 ERK1/2 路徑傳遞訊號。

source_document: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

subject: Humanin

context.en-US: Humanin was cloned by a third group as a binding partner of Bax, a central pro-apoptotic protein that translocates to the mitochondria to initiate a cell death signal. The humanin-Bax complex is retained in the cytoplasm and this interaction protects cells from apoptosis. Humanin also prevents Bax translocation and activation in response to staurosporine, preventing the subsequent release of cytochrome c into the cytoplasm, and binds to Bax-like BH3 proteins Bid and BimEL, inhibiting their pro-apoptotic activity. Endogenous humanin suppresses tBID- and BimEL-induced apoptosis in vitro.
context.zh-TW: Humanin 由第三個團隊作為 Bax 的結合夥伴被選殖，Bax 是核心促凋亡蛋白，會轉位至粒線體以啟動細胞死亡訊號。humanin-Bax 複合物保留在細胞質中，此交互作用保護細胞免於凋亡。Humanin 也阻止 Bax 在星形孢菌素刺激下的轉位與活化，防止隨後細胞色素 c 釋放至細胞質，並可結合 Bax 類 BH3 蛋白 Bid 與 BimEL，抑制其促凋亡活性。內源性 humanin 在體外抑制 tBID 與 BimEL 誘導的凋亡。

source_document: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

subject: Humanin

context.en-US: A second group cloned humanin using a yeast two-hybrid screen as a partner of IGFBP3, and demonstrated that humanin binds to IGFBP3 with high affinity and specificity. IGFBP3 regulates IGF bioactivity and also induces apoptosis and inhibits cell growth independently of IGFs, and humanin protects against IGFBP3-induced apoptosis. Humanin does not interfere with IGF-I/IGFBP-3 binding but appears to bind to the heparin-binding domain of IGFBP-3, and a single amino acid substitution of alanine for phenylalanine at position 6 (F6AHN) abrogates IGFBP-3 binding.
context.zh-TW: 第二個團隊以酵母雙雜交篩選將 humanin 選殖為 IGFBP3 的結合夥伴，並證明 humanin 以高親和力與特異性結合 IGFBP3。IGFBP3 調節 IGF 的生物活性，也獨立於 IGF 誘導凋亡並抑制細胞生長；而 humanin 可保護細胞免受 IGFBP3 誘導的凋亡。Humanin 不干擾 IGF-I/IGFBP-3 的結合，但似乎結合 IGFBP-3 的肝素結合域；第 6 位置苯丙胺酸取代為丙胺酸的單一胺基酸置換（F6AHN）會消除 IGFBP-3 的結合。

source_document: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

subject: Humanin

context.en-US: Humanin levels decline with age, suggesting that a relative deficiency of humanin may be involved in metabolic diseases during aging. In one study, older mice had significantly reduced levels of circulating humanin (2 versus 13 months old), and rats had decreased levels of hypothalamic and skeletal muscle humanin (3 versus 24 months old). Circulating humanin levels also gradually decline with age in humans (45-65 versus 66-80 versus 81-100 years old), and plasma humanin levels significantly decreased with age in healthy volunteers. This decline parallels the age-related increase in risk for diseases humanin protects against.
context.zh-TW: Humanin 濃度隨年齡下降，顯示相對缺乏 humanin 可能與老化期間的代謝疾病有關。在一項研究中，老年小鼠的循環 humanin 濃度顯著降低（2 個月對比 13 個月大），大鼠的下視丘與骨骼肌 humanin 濃度也下降（3 個月對比 24 個月大）。人類的循環 humanin 濃度亦隨年齡逐漸下降（45-65 歲對比 66-80 歲對比 81-100 歲），健康志願者的血漿 humanin 濃度也隨年齡顯著下降。此下降與 humanin 所保護之疾病的年齡相關風險增加呈平行關係。

source_document: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

subject: Humanin

context.en-US: Peripheral intravenous and central intra-cerebro-ventricular infusion of humanin and its derivatives F6AHN, HNG, and HNGF6A significantly improve overall insulin sensitivity, mediated in part by hypothalamic STAT3 activation in rats. The enhanced insulin sensitivity was coupled with a significant reduction of hepatic glucose production together with increased peripheral glucose uptake, raising the rate of glucose infusion in euglycemic clamp studies. A single treatment with the highly-potent analog HNGF6A normalizes blood glucose levels in Zucker diabetic fatty rats, a model of type 2 diabetes.
context.zh-TW: 周邊靜脈與中樞腦室內輸注 humanin 及其衍生物 F6AHN、HNG 與 HNGF6A 可顯著改善整體胰島素敏感性，部分由大鼠下視丘 STAT3 活化所媒介。增強的胰島素敏感性伴隨肝臟葡萄糖生成顯著減少及周邊葡萄糖攝取增加，在正常血糖鉗夾研究中提高了葡萄糖輸注速率。單次使用高效力類似物 HNGF6A 即可使 Zucker 糖尿病肥胖大鼠（第 2 型糖尿病模型）的血糖濃度恢復正常。

source_document: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

subject: Humanin

context.en-US: Humanin is the first small peptide of a putative set of mitochondrial-derived peptides (MDPs), a novel concept that challenges the traditional view of mitochondria as passive end-function organelles. It was discovered in 2001 by screening a cDNA library from the surviving fraction of an Alzheimer's disease patient brain for clones protecting neuronal cells from cell death induced by APP mutants, and identified as a 75bp open reading frame yielding a 24 amino acid peptide encoded within the mitochondrial 16S rRNA. Humanin is a harbinger of additional MDPs, as numerous putative ORFs are dispersed throughout the mitochondrial genome.
context.zh-TW: Humanin 是推定之粒線體衍生胜肽（MDPs）群組中的第一個小胜肽，此一新穎概念挑戰了粒線體是被動終端功能胞器的傳統觀點。它於 2001 年透過篩選阿茲海默症患者腦部存活部分的 cDNA 文庫而被發現，用以尋找可保護神經元細胞免受 APP 突變誘導細胞死亡的選殖株，並被鑑定為 75 bp 的開放閱讀框架，編碼出位於粒線體 16S rRNA 內、由 24 個胺基酸組成的胜肽。Humanin 是更多 MDPs 出現的先兆，因為大量推定的 ORFs 散布於粒線體基因組中。

source_document: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

subject: Humanin

context.en-US: Mitochondria communicate back to the cell through processes collectively referred to as retrograde signaling, and traditionally described means include Ca2+, cytochrome c, and ROS. Mitochondrial-derived peptides such as humanin are recently identified retrograde signals that are unique in that they are encoded within the mitochondrial genome sequences, unlike other retrograde molecules which are nuclear-encoded. Humanin functions as both an endocrine factor and an intracellular survival factor with several biological roles regulating cell survival and metabolism, and retrograde signaling is a biological process well conserved from simple yeast to humans.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體透過統稱為逆向訊號（retrograde signaling）的過程與細胞溝通，傳統上已知的媒介包括 Ca2+、細胞色素 c 與 ROS。粒線體衍生胜肽（如 humanin）是近期發現的逆向訊號，其獨特之處在於編碼於粒線體基因組序列內，不像其他逆向訊號分子由核基因組編碼。Humanin 同時作為內分泌因子與胞內存活因子，具有多種調節細胞存活與代謝的生物功能，而逆向訊號是從簡單酵母到人類皆高度保守的生物過程。

source_document: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

context.en-US: Humanin is a peptide of approximately 24 amino acids believed to derive from a short, cryptic open reading frame within the mitochondrial 16S rRNA gene, and it was the first identified mammalian mitokine. Originally isolated as a protective factor against familial Alzheimer's disease, humanin circulates in plasma and exerts cytoprotective and metabolic effects in various experimental paradigms. It is considered the founding member of a class of mitochondrially-derived peptides (MDPs) causing systemic effects in mammals.
context.zh-TW: Humanin 是約 24 個胺基酸的胜肽，被認為源自粒線體 16S rRNA 基因內一個簡短、隱蔽的開放閱讀框架，是第一個被鑑定的哺乳類 mitokine。最初作為家族性阿茲海默症的保護因子被分離出來，humanin 循環於血漿中，並在各種實驗範式中發揮細胞保護與代謝效應。它被認為是一類粒線體衍生胜肽（MDPs）的創始成員，在哺乳類中造成全身性效應。

subject: Humanin

context.en-US: The mitochondrial origin of humanin is supported by strong circumstantial evidence, though still debated. Northern blot analysis using the humanin ORF as a probe showed hybridization to total RNA from HeLa cells identical in size to mitochondrial 16S rRNA, whereas RNA from rho0 HeLa cells lacking mtDNA showed no significant hybridization. Formylated humanin has enhanced activity by increasing affinity to FPRL1, and N-terminal formylation is a hallmark of mitochondrially encoded proteins. However, NUMTs reflecting humanin sequences are found in chromosomes 1-13 with varying homology, so a NUMT-derived humanin has not been ruled out.
context.zh-TW: Humanin 的粒線體起源受到強烈間接證據支持，但仍有爭議。使用 humanin ORF 作為探針的北方墨點分析顯示，其與 HeLa 細胞總 RNA 的雜交產物大小與粒線體 16S rRNA 相同，而缺乏 mtDNA 的 rho0 HeLa 細胞 RNA 則無顯著雜交。甲醯化的 humanin 因提高對 FPRL1 的親和力而具有增強活性，而 N 端甲醯化是粒線體編碼蛋白質的特徵。然而，反映 humanin 序列的 NUMTs 存在於第 1-13 號染色體且同源性不一，因此源自 NUMT 的 humanin 尚未被排除。

source_document: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

subject: Humanin

context.en-US: The humanin peptide sequence has been proposed to contain a pseudo-signal peptide, and when transfected into neuronal cells humanin is detected in the culture medium, indicating a secretory capacity that is blocked by inhibition of ER-golgi transport processes. Humanin is secreted from cells and found in circulation (plasma) as well as bound to cellular membranes, and its actions are thought to be mediated by specific receptors. This endocrine mode of action distinguishes humanin from other stress-induced mitochondrial retrograde signals, which are cell-autonomous, and supports its role as a non-autonomous signaling factor.
context.zh-TW: Humanin 胜肽序列被提出含有一個偽訊息胜肽，當轉染進入神經元細胞後，humanin 可在培養基中偵測到，顯示其具有分泌能力，而此能力會被 ER-高基氏體運輸過程的抑制所阻斷。Humanin 從細胞分泌並存在於循環（血漿）中，也結合於細胞膜上，其作用被認為是由特定受體所媒介。這種內分泌作用模式使 humanin 有別於其他由壓力誘導、細胞自主性的粒線體逆向訊號，並支持其作為非自主性訊號因子的角色。

source_document: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

subject: Humanin

context.en-US: Humanin modulates oxidative stress and apoptosis in the developing plaque to protect endothelial function and prevent atherosclerosis. Lerman and colleagues treated ApoE-deficient mice fed a high cholesterol diet with the humanin analogue HNGF6A for 16 weeks and showed a dramatic decrease of atherosclerotic plaque size, preserved endothelial function, and improved expression of endothelial nitric oxide synthase in the aorta. Anti-oxidative stress, anti-apoptosis, and preservation of eNOS are mechanisms partially responsible for the protection against atherosclerosis by humanin.
context.zh-TW: Humanin 調節發展中斑塊內的氧化壓力與細胞凋亡，以保護內皮功能並預防動脈粥狀硬化。Lerman 及其同事以 humanin 類似物 HNGF6A 治療餵食高膽固醇飲食的 ApoE 缺陷小鼠 16 週，結果顯示動脈粥狀硬化斑塊大小顯著減少、內皮功能獲得保存，且主動脈中內皮型一氧化氮合成酶的表現獲得改善。抗氧化壓力、抗細胞凋亡及保存 eNOS 是 humanin 對抗動脈粥狀硬化保護作用的部分機制。

source_document: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

subject: Humanin

context.en-US: Humanin's cytoprotective effects were first tested and confirmed in vitro against mutant forms of APP and presenilin 1 and 2 which cause familial AD. F11 neuronal cells were challenged by transfecting APP or PS1/2 cDNA or treating with Abeta1-43, and humanin effectively protected neuronal cells from these FAD-related toxicities as shown by trypan blue exclusion and WST-8 assays. Humanin also protects against Abeta25-35 cell death and behavioral deficits, scopolamine-induced memory loss, H2O2-induced cell death in cortical neurons, serum starvation-induced apoptosis, and CoCl2-induced apoptosis in retinal ganglion cells.
context.zh-TW: Humanin 的細胞保護作用首次在體外針對導致家族性 AD 的 APP 與 presenilin 1 和 2 突變形式進行測試並獲得證實。F11 神經元細胞透過轉染 APP 或 PS1/2 cDNA 或處理 Abeta1-43 進行挑戰，humanin 有效保護神經元細胞免受這些 FAD 相關毒性傷害，如台盼藍排除法與 WST-8 分析所示。Humanin 也保護免受 Abeta25-35 誘導的細胞死亡與行為缺陷、東莨菪鹼誘導的記憶喪失、皮質神經元中 H2O2 誘導的細胞死亡、血清剝奪誘導的細胞凋亡，以及視網膜神經節細胞中 CoCl2 誘導的細胞凋亡。

source_document: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

subject: Humanin

context.en-US: Humanin improves glucose tolerance and delays the onset of diabetes in NOD mice, a model of type 1 diabetes involving progressive accumulation of lymphocytes within the pancreatic islets of Langerhans. In NOD mouse pancreata, humanin treatment dramatically suppressed inflammation and lymphocyte infiltration. Furthermore, humanin decreases serum starvation- and cytokine-induced apoptosis in the pancreatic beta-cell line NIT-1, protecting against the IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, and IFN-gamma released by T cells and activated macrophages, in an ERK- and STAT3-dependent manner, suggesting it may be a therapeutic target for type 1 diabetes.
context.zh-TW: Humanin 改善 NOD 小鼠的葡萄糖耐受性並延遲糖尿病的發生；NOD 小鼠是第 1 型糖尿病模型，其特徵為淋巴球在胰臟蘭氏小島內逐漸累積。在 NOD 小鼠胰臟中，humanin 治療顯著抑制發炎與淋巴球浸潤。此外，humanin 降低胰臟 beta 細胞株 NIT-1 中血清剝奪與細胞激素誘導的細胞凋亡，以 ERK 與 STAT3 依賴的方式保護細胞免受 T 細胞與活化巨噬細胞釋放的 IL-1beta、TNF-alpha 與 IFN-gamma 傷害，顯示它可能是第 1 型糖尿病的治療標靶。

subject: Humanin

context.en-US: Humanin was originally discovered in 2001 by screening a cDNA library created from the surviving fraction of an Alzheimer's disease patient brain, using unbiased functional screening for clones that protect neuronal cells from cell death induced by amyloid precursor protein (APP) mutants associated with early-onset familial AD. The term humanin was coined by its discoverer, Professor Nishimoto, to denote the potential of this molecule to restore the humanity of patients with Alzheimer's disease. Humanin protects against Abeta25-35-induced cell death, behavioral deficits, and memory impairment in mice, and is protective in 3xTg-AD triple-transgenic AD mice, with cell surface receptor FPRL1 linked to AD-related cytoprotection.
context.zh-TW: Humanin 最初於 2001 年被發現，方法是篩選由阿茲海默症患者腦部存活部分建構的 cDNA 文庫，以非偏倚的功能性篩選尋找能保護神經元細胞免受與早發性家族性 AD 相關之澱粉樣前驅蛋白（APP）突變誘導細胞死亡的選殖株。Humanin 一詞由其發現者西本（Nishimoto）教授所創造，用以表示此分子恢復阿茲海默症患者人性（humanity）的潛力。Humanin 在小鼠中保護免受 Abeta25-35 誘導的細胞死亡、行為缺陷與記憶障礙，並在 3xTg-AD 三轉基因 AD 小鼠中具有保護作用，細胞表面受體 FPRL1 與 AD 相關的細胞保護有關。

subject: Humanin

context.en-US: Several laboratories have tested the protective effect of humanin on various types of stress or disease states, including myocardial ischemia/reperfusion injury in mice and cerebral ischemia/reperfusion injury in rats, as well as focal cerebral ischemia in mice as a stroke model. Humanin also protects against familial ALS in mice expressing mutant SOD1, dexamethasone-induced apoptosis in rat Leydig cells, and IGFBP-3-induced apoptosis in cerebral endothelial cells. Many of these stressors and models have oxidative stress as a common mechanistic denominator, suggesting a specific oxidative-insult-related cytoprotective role of humanin.
context.zh-TW: 數個實驗室已測試 humanin 對各種壓力或疾病狀態的保護作用，包括小鼠的心肌缺血/再灌流損傷與大鼠的腦缺血/再灌流損傷，以及作為中風模型的小鼠局部腦缺血。Humanin 也保護表現突變 SOD1 的小鼠免於家族性 ALS、保護大鼠 Leydig 細胞免於地塞米松誘導的細胞凋亡，並保護腦內皮細胞免於 IGFBP-3 誘導的細胞凋亡。這些壓力源與模型中有許多以氧化壓力為共同的機制性分母，顯示 humanin 具有特定針對氧化傷害的細胞保護角色。

subject: Humanin

context.en-US: Humanin restores ATP levels in lymphocytes from MELAS patients, preventing them from falling into energy deficiency. MELAS is a mitochondrial disorder strongly associated with the A3243G mutant mitochondrial DNA, a location immediately downstream of the 16S rRNA locus, and MELAS patients have defective ATP synthesis which causes tissue damage especially in high-energy-demand tissues. Notably, humanin levels are considerably elevated in skeletal muscles of patients with MELAS and chronic progressive external ophthalmoplegia, likely because the stress conferred by these pathological states induces elevated humanin levels.
context.zh-TW: Humanin 恢復 MELAS 患者淋巴球中的 ATP 濃度，防止其陷入能量缺乏。MELAS 是一種粒線體疾病，與 A3243G 突變粒線體 DNA 密切相關，該位置緊鄰 16S rRNA 基因座下游，且 MELAS 患者的 ATP 合成有缺陷，造成組織損傷，尤其在高能量需求組織中。值得注意的是，MELAS 與慢性進行性外眼肌麻痺患者的骨骼肌中 humanin 濃度顯著升高，可能是因為這些病理狀態造成的壓力誘導了 humanin 濃度升高。
